tsha3 — — — lko tsho cardokhye shes ri rtemi di ci —— cici 〉(rnyeX ciX sngo po6wa/( che/ sna tsho zhe na tsho ci nga daX4/ ri shāmiXdu ra rme tsho kā dzhaX ༷ ༷ ngaXring pa/— — cho 0 5 ) ri 3—— 7 5)ri 3 5 4 riri ༷༷ di tsho rdo mo da ci pa1 —— sde'i pa nga sna ji tsa nga to/de 'i tsho ༷༷ ( 4)sgoriX sgo cho da tsho' tshorme ci nga sto da —— ——de du bye pho ris zhe /spya ༷swā /ci 〉 la ba stse rā sa ru ne na 〉rsā /rnye/ staX /rshatā rtsirdoṣṭha//thi tsho /cho sto mi / — zhe snye /spra nge casi dhe kau mi rdo ༷ — snye ༷pas ciX tī/mi /༷tsā tsho /ri ༷/ ji caX ——— )ji ga — — rdo pa tsho 4 ༄ rnama'adrenabazhi/shā9tog ri

mdo sme/ () (51)0131 dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 3dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ thabs la mkhas pa'i le'u/ 29gsum pa/ dpe'i le'u/ 57bzhi pa/ mos pa'i le'u/ 92lnga pa/ sman gyi le'u/ 109drug pa/ nyan thos lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 128bdun pa/ sngon gyi sbyor ba'i le'u/ 138brgyad pa/ dge slong lnga brgya lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 177dgu pa/ kun dga' bo dang sgra gcan zin dang dge slong nyis stong lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 190bcu pa/ chos smra ba'i le'u/ 1981

bcu gcig pa/ mchod rten bstan pa'i le'u/ 210bcu gnyis pa/ spro bar bya ba'i le'u/ 237bcu gsum pa/ bde bar gnas pa'i le'u/ 244bcu bzhi pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sa rum nas 'thon pa'i le'u/ 261bco lnga pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshe'i tshad kyi le'u/ 279bcu drug pa/ bsod nams kyi rnam grangs kyi le'u/ 290bcu bdun pa/ rjes su yi rang ba'i bsod nams bstan pa'i le'u/ 305bco brgyad pa/ skye mched drug rnam par dag pa'i phan yon gyi le'u/ 313bcu dgu pa/ rtag tu brnyas pa'i le'u/ 330nyi shu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du byed pa'i le'u/ 339nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ gzungs sngags kyi le'u/ 347nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ sman gyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi sbyor ba'i le'u/ 354nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ sang sang po'i dbyangs kyi le'u/ 374nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa kun nas sgo'i le'u/ 389nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ rgyal po dge ba bkod pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba'i le'u/ 401nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ kun tu bzang pos spro bar bya ba'i le'u/ 413nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 423rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rin dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba ban de sna nam ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(427) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(476)0132 'phags pa chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 4772

rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā bar ma dang / su rin dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(511) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(515)0133 'phags pa bde ba can gyi bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 516rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(526) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(528)0134 'phags pa za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 529le'u dang po/ 529le'u gnyis pa/ 572rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(640) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(655)0135 'phags pa dkon mchog gi za ma tog ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 656zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba ban de ratna rakṣi tas zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/

bsdur mchan/(752) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(763)0136 'phags pa rin po che'i mtha' zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 764rgya /kā ༵ ༷༷ na rdo sras // / ༵ so/gas rdo/ bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(780 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(786)che
nyi so tshocu ga/ da ba da nams gas na dpal/ / / ga dang zhabs sa ldan pa ra/ /cugro ge PROB PROB PROBdza tsha tsha tsha' la ba da ma da dan/ / ngas par sa pa ngas pa ma na/ /

sngag /dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/tsho1༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ sad dharma du puṇa ḍa rī snaraka nā ma ma 54 hā yā ri snen sru tra/ bod skad du/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po56ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la bzhugs te/ dge slong khri nyis stong gi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par gyur pa/sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ri khur bor ba/bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems kyi dbang thams 51—3

cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa/ mngon par shes pas 1mngon par shes pa'i nyan thos chen po sha stag la 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kauṇḍi n+ya dang ske/ tshe dang ldan pa rta thul dang / tshe dang ldan pa rlangs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa ming chen dang / tshe dang ldan pa bzang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung 2chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ltang 3rgyas 'od srung cadang / tshe dang ldan pa chu klung 'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa ga ya 5'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod 6gal gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa kā kyā'i bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa nam gru dang / tshe dang ldan pa ka 7pi na dang / tshe dang ldan pa ba lang bdag dang / tshe dang ldan pa pi lin da'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa bsku 8la dang ske/ tshe dang ldan pa gsus po che dang / tshe dang ldan pa bha ra dwa dza 9dang /tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo dang / tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' dang / tshe dang ldan pa mdzes dga' dang / tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan zin dang / de dag dang nyan thos chen po gzhan dag dang / slob pa tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang /gzhan yang slob pa dang mi slob pa'i dge slong nyis stong dang / skyem/ nodagu'i bdag mo chen mo la sogs pa dge slong ma drug stong dang / sgra gcan zin gyi ma 11dge slong ma grags 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa dang thabs cig 12go/ /byang chub sems dpa' brgyad khri thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag pa ra rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa/ gzungs thob pa/ spobs pa chen po la gnas pa / phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor dab/ sangs rgyas brgya stong mang po 57—4

la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ sangs rgyas brgya stong mang po la dge ba'i 1rtsa ba bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas brgya stong mang pos yang dag par bstod pa/ lus dang ngag dang sems byams pas yongs su bsgos pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes 'dzud pa la mkhas pa/ shes rab chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs par khong du chud napa/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong mang por rnam par grags pa/ srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po yang dag par sgrol ba sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob dang / byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad ces bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu brtson dang /byang chub sems dpa' brtson pa mi gtong ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin chen dang / byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sman yang dag 5'phags dang / byang chub sems dpa' bkod pa'i rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rab tu sbyin dpa' cadang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen zla ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rin chen 'od dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' zla gang dang / byang chub sems dpa' gnon pa chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas gnon dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gsum gnon dang / byang chub sems dpa' spobs 5pa chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag par rgyun tu brtson dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa 'dzin dang / byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' 51—5

skar ma'i rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po seng ge dag dang yang thabs cig go/ /bzang skyong la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa bcu drug la 1'di lta ste/ bzang skyong dang /dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang / ded dpon bzang po dang / mes 2byin dang ske/ phug sbas dang / chus dbyin dang / dbang pos byin dang / bla ma'i blo gros dang / khyad par blo gros dang / 'phel ba'i blo gros dang / mthong ba don yod dang / shin tu yang dag zhugs dang / rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa dang / dpe med blo gros dang / nyi ma'i snying po dang / sa 'dzin dag dang yang thabs cig ste/ de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' brgyad khri dag dang yang thabs cig go/ /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang /'khor lha'i bu nyi khri 'di lta ste/ lha'i bu zla ba dang / lha'i bu nyi ma dang /kun du dri dang / rin chen 'od dang / lha'i bu snang 'od dang / de dag la sogs pa lha'i bu nyi khri dang yang thabs cig go/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi dang /'khor lha'i bu sum khri 'di lta ste/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang / lha'i bu dbang phyug dang / lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po dang / 'khor lha'i bu sum khri dag dang yang thabs cig go/ /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / 'khor tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu khri nyis stong 'di lta ste/tshangs pa gtsug phud can dang / tshangs pa skar ma'i 'od dang / de dag la sogs pa tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu khri nyis stong dang yang thabs cig go/ /klu'i rgyal po brgyad 'di lta ste/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' dang / rgya mtsho 51—6

dang norargyasabye/ce/ 'arjorsharākod gzi rsha ce ——— kā se~X dang ske/ klu'i rgyal po ud pa 91la dang / 'khor klu bye ba brgya stong mang po dag dang yang thabs cig go/ /mi'am ci'i rgyal po bzhi 'di lta ste/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po chos chen nadang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po chos bzang dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po chos 'dzin dang / 'khor mi'am ci bye ba brgya stong mang po dag dang yang thabs cig go/ /dri za'i ris kyi lha'i bu bzhi 'di lta ste/ dri za yid du 'ong ba dang / yid 'ong dbyangs dang /'jam snyan dang / dri za dbyangs snyan dang / 'khor dri za bye ba brgya stong mang po dag dang yang thabs cig go/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po bzhi 'di lta ste/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po stobs can dang / phrag rtsub dang / thags bzangs ris dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan dang / 'khor lha ma yin bye ba brgya stong mang po dag dang yang thabs cig go/ /nam mkha' lding gi dbang po bzhi 'di lta ste/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang po gzi brjid chen po dang / lus chen53)dang / rdzogs chen dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po 'phrul chen thob dang ske/ 'khor nam mkha' lding bye ba brgya stong mang po dag 5dang yang thabs cig go/ /lus 'phags ma'i bu yul ma ga dma'i rgyal po ma skyes dgra dang yang thabs cig go/ /de'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi po de dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas te/ bste 6)stang du byas/ btsun par byas/ri mor byas/ mchod par byas/ rjed )par byas/ gsol ba 8byas te/nges par bstan pa chen po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs mdo sde shin tu rgyas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' rnams 9la gdams pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad 57—7

kyis yongs su bzung ba bshad par bzhed 1de chos kyi gdan de nyid la skyil mo krung nabacas nas/ mtha' yas nges par bstan pa'i gnas zhes sa bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te casku mi g.yo zhing sems mi g.yo bar gyur nas bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das la lha'i me tog man dā par dang / man dā ner chen po dang / mañdzu ṣa 7ka zhedang / mañdzu ṣa ‘ ka chen po rnams kyi me tog gi char chen po mngon par 10bab ste/ bcom ldan 'das dang 'khor bzhi po de dag la 'thor ro thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur te/'gul kun tu rab tu 'gul/ ldeg kun tu rab tu ldeg /'khrugs kun tu rab tu 'khrugs so/ /de'i tshe dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang ske/ dge bsnyen ma dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang ske/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams dang / rgyal phran dang /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur 11ba dang / gling bzhi'i 'khor los sgyur 12ba gang dag 'khor der 'dus nas 'khod par gyur pa 'khor dang bcas pa de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das la lta zhing 'khod de ngo mtshar du gyur/ rmad du gyur/shin tu dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams 15kyi mdzod spu nas 'od zer gcig byung nas/ de shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing khri brgyad stong du song ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen po yan chad srid pa'i rtse mo man chad 'od zer de'i 'od kyis shin tu khyab par snang ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi 'gro ba 51—8

drug po de dag na sems can gang yod pa de dag thams cad ma lus par snang ngo //sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs shing 'tsho gzhes 1 pa de dag thams cad kyang snang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag tshonachos gang 'chad pa de dag thams cad kyang ma lus par grag go/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / rnal 'byor can dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa gang dag 'bras bu thob pa dang / 'bras bu ma thob pa de dag thams cad kyang snang ngo glu/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag nyan pa dang / dmigs pa dang / mos pa rnam pa sna tshogs du ma'i rgyu'i thabs la rnamakhas pa dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa de dag thams cad kyang snang ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba de dag thams cad kyang snang ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa rnams kyi ring bsrel gyi mchod rten rin po che las byas pa de dag thams cad kyang snang ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma de bzhin gshegs pas ltas cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa 'di 'dir ci'i rgyur 'gyur zhig gu /ci'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis ltas cho 'phrul chen po 'di lta bu 'di ci bstan te/bcom ldan 'das kyang ting nge 'dzin de ( la snyoms par zhugs shing rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba chen po 7bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di lta bu 'di dag kyang snang bar gyur pa 'di'i don bdag gis su la dri 'di na don 57—9

'di'i lan ldon nus pa ni su yod snyam mo/ /de yang 'di snyam du 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'di sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed 1pa/ sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa ste/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'dis sngon chad kyang sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ltas 'di lta bu byung ba rnams mthong zhing sngon chad chos chen po'i tsho 'bel ba'i gtam dag kyang myong bas na/ bdag gis 3'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la de'i don dri'o snyam du sems so/ /dge slong dang dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma'i 'khor bzhi po de dag dang / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa mang po de dag kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi ltas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po'i snang ba 'di lta bu 'di mthong nas/ ngo mtshar du gyur rmad du gyur ltad mor gyur te/ 'di snyam du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chen po'i snang ba 'di lta bu 'di bstan pa bdag cag gis su la dri snyam du sems so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa/'a chen po byams pas skad cig thang cig yud tsam de nyid la 'khor bzhi po rnams kyi sems kyi rnam par rtog pa sems kyis 4shes nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal bcom ldan 'das kyis ltas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rdzu 'phrul gyi snang ba 'di lta bu 'di bstan te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khri brgyad stong po 'di dag rnam par bkra ba/ mchog tu blta zin sdug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa sngon du bzhud pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su 'dren par 51—10

snang ba 'di'i rgyu gang rkyen gang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'jam dpal ci yi phyir na 'di lta bu/ /mi yi mgon pos 'od zer gcig pus1)'di/ /zhal gyi smin mtshams kyi ni mdzod spu nanas/ /shin tu snang ba'i 'od zer rab tu btang / /lha rnams dga' bas tsan dan phye ma dang / /lha yi spos rab yid du 'ong ba dang / / man bāmo cir dang mañdzu ṣa 4ka yi/ /me tog dag gis char chen rab tu phab/ /des ni sa 'di kun tu mdzes gyur cing / /'khor bzhi 'di dag dga' ba rab tu thob/ /zhing rnams 'di dag thams cad rnam drug tu/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs su kun nas g.yos/ /'od zer de yis shar gyi phyogs logs kyi/ /zhing ni stong phrag bcwa 6brgyad tshang ba 7rnams / /skad cig gcig gis thams cad rab tu snang / /zhing rnams gser gyi kha dog bzhin du mdzes/ /mnar med yan chad srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /zhing de dag na sems can ji snyed pa/ /'gro ba drug po de na yod pa rnams/ /gang dag der yang shi 'pho skye ba rnams/ /de dag las kyi rnam pa sna tshogs dang //'gro ba bde dang mi bde rnams kyang snang / /bzang po ngan pa de bzhin bar ma yang ske/ /'di na 'dug kyang de dag thams cad mthong / /sangs rgyas seng ge mi yi 8)dbang po rnams/ /chos nyid rab ston rnam par dbye ba mthong / /sems can bye ba mang la rab ston pa/ /snyan pa'i sgra dang dbyangs su gsung ba dag /zab cing rgya che rmad du byung ba'i sgra/ /so so'i zhing rnams su yang rab tu 'byin/ /dpe dang gtan tshigs khrag khrig bye ba 9yis/ /sangs rgyas chos 'dir rab tu ston pa ni/ /sems can gang rnams sdug bsngal gzir ba dag /skye dang rga 57—11

bas yid skyo mi shes la/ /'di ni dge slong sdug bsngal tha ma zhes/ /de la rab zhi mya ngan 'das pa ston/ /mi rnams gang gis rgya che mthu thob cing / /sangs rgyas mthong bas de bzhin bsod nams ldan/ /de dag la ni chos tshul 'di brjod cing / /rang rgyal theg pa yang ni ston pa mdzad/ /gzhan yang bde bar gshegs pa'i sras po gang / /bla na med pa'i 17ye shes tshol 2)ba dag /bya ba sna tshogs rtag tu byed pa la/ /de dag la ni byang chub phyir bsngags gsung / /'di na 'dug bzhin de na 'di 'dra dang / /khyad par gzhan yang stong phrag bye ba dag /shin tu mthong zhing thos te 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /de dag las ni phyogs tsam smos par bya/ /bdag mthong zhing rnams mang po de dag na'ang / /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i bye ma snyed/ /gang rnams bye ba stong phrag mi nyung ba/ /brtson 'grus rnam pa mang pos byang chub skyed/ /la la sbyin pa sbyin pa'ang de bzhin te/ /nor dang 'gron dbu gser dang dngul rnams dang / /mu tig nor bu man shel byi ru dang / /bran pho bran mo rta dang shing rta lug /de bzhin rin chen dag gis brgyan pa'i khyogs/ /yongs su dga' ba'i yid kyis sbyin pa gtong ske/ /bdag cag gis kyang theg mchog snye thob shog ces/ /byang chub mchog 'dir yongs su sngo bar byed6/ /sbyin pa 'di 'dra 'di dag byin 7byas na/khams gsum nang na theg mchog khyad par can/ /sangs rgyas theg pa bde gshegs gang bsngags 8pa/ /de ni bdag gis myur du thob gyur cig /la la 9rta bzhi can gyi shing rta la/ /kha khyer bcas pa me tog rgyal mtshan brgyan/ /rin chen dag las byas pa'i ba dan can/ /la las de lta bu yang sbyin pa byin/ /de bzhin bu dang chung ma rnams kyang byin/ /la la phangs pa'i sha yang sbyin par byed//57—12

byang chub dam pa 'di ni tsholas1ba'i phyir/ /lag pa dang ni rkang pa bslangs nan byin / /la la dag gis rnamago dang la las mig /la la bdag gis rilus mchog rab kyang gtong / / dang ba'i 5sems kyis sbyin pa rnams byin nas/ /de bzhin gshegs kyi ye shes don du gnyer/ /'jam dpal bdag gis mthong ba la la na/ /rgyal srid skyid pa rnam par spang 6byas te/ /btsun mo'i 'khor dang de bzhin gling kun dang / /gnyen dang blon po thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /'jig rten rnam par 'dren gyi drung dong ste/ /zhi ba'i phyir ni chos rab mchog 'dri zhing / /ngur smrig gos rnams rab tu gyon byed de/ /skra dang kha spu dag kyang 'dreg 7par byed/ /bdag mthong byang chub sems dpa' la la ni/ /dge slong gyur cing nags tshal gnas pa dag /dgon pa stong pa rnams su gnas 'cha' zhing / /la la lung nod kha ton byed la dga'/ /bdag mthong byang chub sems dpa' la la dag /ri sul dag tu zhugs pa'i brtan pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'di la rnam par sgom/ /yongs su sems shing nye bar rtogs par byed / /kha cig gis ni 'dod pa ma lus spangs/ /yongs bsgoms bdag nyid spyod yul rnam par dag /mngon par shes pa lnga yang der thob nas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sras po dgon par gnas / /brtan pa la la rkang gshibs der gnas te/ /'dren pa'i spyan sngar thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /dga' ba bskyed de rgyal dbang rgyal po la/ /tshigs su bcad pa stong gis namangon par bstod/ /dran dang ldan zhing dul ba mi 'jigs pa/ /la la spyod pa phra ba shes pa dag /rkang gnyis gtso la chos kyang 'dri bar byed/ /thos nas de dag chos rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ /yongs bsgoms bdag nyid rgyal dbang sras po rnams/ /51—13

la la dag gis de dang der mthong ba/ /dpe dang gtan tshigs khrag khrig du ma yis / /srog chags bye ba mang la chos rnams ston/ /mchog tu dga' skyes chos rnams rab ston cing / /byang chub sems dpa' mang po yang dag 'dzud/ /bdud rnams stobs dang bzhin par bcas bcom ste/ /chos kyi rnga 'di shin tu rdung bar byed/ /la la bde bar gshegs pa'i 37bstan pa la/ /bde dgashegs sras la lha mi gnod sbyin dang / /srin pos mchod kyang ngo mtshar mi 'dzin cing / /bsnyems 5med zhi zhing rab zhi spyod pa mthong / /phal cher nags gnas de bzhin gzhan dag kyang / /snang ba'i 'od ni lus las rab gtong ste/ /sems can dmyal nas sems can rnams 'don cing / /de dag byang chub la yang yang dag 'dzud/ /rgyal ba'i sras po la la brtson 'grus gnas/ /kha cig gis kyang ma lus gnyid spangs nas/ /'chag pa byed cing nags tshal gnas pa dag /de dag brtson pas byang chub mchog la zhugs/ /la la tshul khrims ma ral srung ba ni//rtag tu rnam dag nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /la la spyad pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur / /de dag khrims kyis byang chub mchog la zhugs/ /rgyal sras la la bzod pa'i stobs can te/ /dge slong nga rgyal can dag khro ba dang / /de ba/zhin gshe zhing sdig lapa'ang bzod par byed/ /bzod pas de dag byang chub mchog la zhugs / /bdag mthong byang chub sems dpa' la la ni/ /rtseda'5mo dga' ba thams cad rnam spangs te/ /byis pa'i grogs po rnams kyang yongs spangs nas/ /'phags pa rnams dang 'grogs dga' mnyam par gzhag6 /rnam par g.yeng ba'i sems ni rnam 7spangs nas/ /lo stong bye bar nags 8dang ri sul na/ /rtse gcig sems su bsam gtan byed pa rnams/ /de dag bsam gtan byang chub 51—14

mchog la zhugs/ /dge 'dun slob bcas rgyal ba mngon sum du/ /bza' dang bca' dang de bzhin zas dang skom/ /na ba'i sman ni mi nyung mang po dag /kha cig de ltar sbyin pa sbyin par byed/ /dge 'dun slob bcas rgyal ba mngon sum 1du / /de dag gos brgya bye ba sbyin par byed/ /la la stong phrag bye ba brgya ri dang ske/ /rin thang med pa'i gos rnams rab tu 'bul/ /rin po che dang de bzhin tsan dan gyi/ /gtsug lag khang ni bye ba brgya byas nasan/ /stan dang mal cha mang pos brgyan pa rnams/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la mngon sum 5'bul / /kun dga' ra ba yid 'ong gtsang ma rnams/ /me tog 'bras bu sna tshogs ldan pa dag /skyes bu khyu mchog nyan thos bcas pa la/ /la la nyin par zhugs phyir rab tu 'bul/ /dga' ba skyes nas sna tshogs rnam mang po/ /de lta bu yi 4risbyin pa sbyin par byed/ /byin nas byang chub phyir yang brtson 'grus bskyed / /sbyin pas de dag byang chub mchog la zhugs/ /la la zhi ba'i chos kyang rab 'chad de/ /dpe dang gtan tshigs khrag khrig du ma yis/ /de dag srog chags bye ba stong la ston/ /de dag ye shes byang chub mchog la zhugs/ /byed pa med pa'i chos rab shes pa ni/ /gnyis med rab zhugs nam mkha' mtshungs 'dra bske/ /ma chags bde bar gshegs pa'i sras po rnams/ /de dag shes rab byang chub mchog la zhugs/ /bdag gis gzhan yang mthong ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bder gshegs mya ngan 'das pa'i bstan pa pa la/ /byang chub sems dpa' brtan pa mang byung nas/ /rgyal ba'i ring bsrel dag la rim gro byed/ /mchod rten 6bye ba stong phrag mi nyung ba/ /ji ltar gang gā'i klung gi bye ma bzhin/ /gang gis bye ba'i 7zhing rnams rtag brgyan pa/ /rgyal sras de dag byed du 'jug pa 51—15

mthong —/ /rin chen sna bdun mchog gi rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /de na bye ba stong rnams bsgreng ba ni/ /'phang du dpag tshad lnga stong phyin pa ste/ /khor 1yug tu ni dpag tshad nyis nastong yod/ /rnam rgyal ba dan bcas pa khor mor mdzes/ /dril dang dril bu g.yer kha rtag tu 'khrol/ /me tog dri dang de bzhin sil snyan gyis / /lha mi srin po gnod sbyin rnams kyis mchod/ /yongs 'dus 3shing gi me tog rgyas pa bzhin/ /de ltar phyogs bcu de dag mdzes byas te/ /rgyal ba'i ring bsrel dag la 'di 'dra 'dir/ /bde gshegs sras kyis mchod pa byed du btsud / /rgyal bas 'od zer gcig pu ca'adi btang 5bas/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten 'di dag rab rgyas pa/ /bdag dang srog chags bye ba mang po 'dis/ /'di na 'dug bzhin de dag thams cad mthong / /gang gis 'od zer gcig pu deng zhibatang bas/ /zhing rnams stong phrag mang por ston pa de/ /kye ma skyes bu khyu mchog de yi mthu/ /kye ma ye shes rgya che zag med do/ /rmad du byung ba tshad med 'di 'dra ba'i/ /ltas rnams mthong nas bdag cag ngo mtshar gyur/ /'di yi don rnams 'jam dbyangs rab ston te/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams the tshom kyigyur pa stsol8/ /'khor bzhi 'di dag rab tu dga' sems kyis/ /dpa' bo khyod dang bdag la mngon par lta/ /bde bar gshegs pas de ring ci yi phyir/ /snang ba 'di 'dra 'di ni rab tu btang / /bde gshegs sras po khyod kyis (lung ston la/ /dga' ba skyed cing the tshom rnam par sol1 / /'di ltar 'od zer rgya chen rab btang 1 ba/ /de dag ci 'dra'i don du 'gyur ba zhig /bde bar gshegs pa skyes bu dam pa yis/ /byang chub snying por chos mchog gang brnyes pa//de dag 'jig rten mgon po 'dir 'chad dam/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di 51—16

dag lung ston tam/ /zhing rnams stong phrag du ma gang bstan pa/ /sna tshogs rab tu bkra ba rin chen brgyan/ /mtha' yas spyan can sangs rgyas rnams snang bske/ /'di ni mi chud rgyur 'gyur gor ma chag /rgyal ba'i sras la byams pas kun dris nas/ /lha mi gnod sbyin srin po de dag dga'/ /'jam dbyangs 'dir ni ci zhig lung ston ces/ /'khor rnams bzhi po de dag shin tu sdod/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs de la smras pa/ rigs kyi bu dag 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa chos chen po bsgrags pa'i 'bel 1ba'i gtam mdzad par dgongs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi char chen po mngon par dbab 2pa dang /chos kyi rnga chen po rab tu brdung 3ba dang / chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po rab tu labasgreng ba dang / chos kyi sgron ma snye chen po rab tu 'bar bar mdzad pa dang /chos kyi dung chen po rab tu 'bud pa dang / chos kyi rnga bo che chen po rab tu brdung 6ba dang / chos bstan pa chen po mdzad par dgongs pa ste/ rigs kyi bu dag bdag ji ltar spobs pa dang / ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi snga ltas 'di lta bu 'di bdag gis mthong ste/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis kyang / 'od zer gyi snang ba 'di btang bas/ bdag ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa yang chos chen po bsgrag napa'i 'bel ba'i gtam mdzad par bzhed pa dang / chos chen po bsgrags 1 pa thos par mdzad pa bzhed pas 'di lta bu'i snga ltas 'di mdzad pa snyam byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom 51—17

pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten thams cad dang mi 'thun nyuripa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bsgrag par bzhed pas snga ltas cho 'phrul chen po 'od zer rab tu btang 5ba'i snang ba 'di lta bu 'di ston to/ /rigs kyi bu dag 5bdag gis dran pa 'das la pa'i dus na bskal pa grangs med pa'i yang ches grangs med pa yangs pa dpag tu med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpag gis mi lang ba tshad med pa de'i pha rol gyi yang ches pha rol tu gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar 5)gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyi zla sgron ma zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ des chos bstan pa tshangs par spyod pa thog mar dge ba bar du dge ba tha mar dge ba don bzang po tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa yongs su byang ba yang dag par ston te 'di lta ste/ nyan thos rnams la ni skye ba dang rga ba dang /na ba dang 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang —/ yid mi bde ba dang 'khrug rdzu pa las shin tu bzla 7ba'i phyir/ 7 ngan las 'das pa'i mthar thug pa 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang ldan pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la 'jug pa'i chos ston to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las 8brtsams te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi mthar thug pa'i chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla sgron ma de'i pha rol gyi 57—18

yang ches pha rol na/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 1yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla sgron ma zhes bya ba zhig 'jig rten du byung ste ma pham pa 'di ltar snga rol dang snga rol brjod pa'i tshul 'dis/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla sgron ma zhes bya bar mtshan gcig pa rigs dang gdung gcig pa sha stag ste/ 'di ltar bha ra dwa nadza'i rigs su 'thun pa de bzhin gshegs pa nyi khri byung ngo / /ma pham pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa nyi khri po de dag thog ma'i de bzhin gshegs pa nas tha ma'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bar du de dag gis chos bshad pa yang / tshangs par spyod pa thog mar dge ba bar du dge ba tha mar dge ba don bzang po tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa yongs su byang ba yang dag par ston te 'di lta ste/ nyan thos rnams la ni skye ba 5dang rga ba dang na ba 4dang 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba dang 'khrug pa las shin tu bzla 5ba'i phyir/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar 6 thug pa 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang ldan pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la 'jug pa'i chos ston to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las 7brtsams te/pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa rnam pa 8thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi mthar thug pa'i chos ston to/ /ma pham pa 'di ltar yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla sgron ma de sngon gzhon nur gyur cing khab na bzhugs pa las mngon par ma byung ba'i tshe sras brgyad yod par gyur te 'di lta ste/ rgyal bu gzhon nu blo gros zhes bya ba 51—19

dang ske/ bzang po'i blo gros dang / mtha' yas blo gros dang / dkon mchog blo gros dang / khyad par blo gros dang / the tshom kun bcom dang / dbyangs kyi blo gros dang / rgyal bu gzhon nu chos kyi blo gros zhes bya ba yod do/ /ma pham pa bcom ldan 'das nyi zla sgron ma de'i sras rgyal bu gzhon nu brgyad po de dag rdzu 'phrul chen por gyur te/ de dag re re yang gling chen po bzhi la kun tu longs spyod par gyur cing de dag na 1rgyal po byed do/ /de dag gis bcom ldan 'das de khab nas mngon par byung bar shes shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnamangon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par thos nas/ rgyal po'i longs spyod thams cad spangs te/ bcom ldan 'das de'i rjes su rab tu byung nas thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs te chos smra bar gyur to/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu de dag rtag tu tshangs par spyod cing sangs rgyas brgya stong mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par gyur to/ /ma pham pa de'i tshe na yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla sgron ma des/ nges par bstan pa chen po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs mdo sde shin tu rgyas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yongs su bzung 4ba bshad nas/ de'i tshe skad cig thang cig yud tsam de nyid la 'khor 'dus pa de nyid du chos kyi gdan chen po de nyid la skyil mo krung bcas te/ mtha' yas nges par bstan pa'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te sku mi g.yo zhing sems mi g.yo bar gyur nas bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das de snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog man dā par ba dang /57—20

man dā 3snar ba chen po dang / mañdzu ṣa 2ka dang / mañdzu ṣa dka chen po dang /lha'i me tog dag gi 4char chen po mngon par bab ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la mngon par 'thor ru ro/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos par gyur te/ 'gul kun tu rab tu 'gulam/ ldeg kun tu rab tu ldeg /'khrugs kun tu rab tu 'khrugs so/ ma pham pa yang de'i tshe 'khor der dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams dang / rgyal phran dang /stobs kyi ne'akhor los 7sgyur ba dang / gling bzhi'i 'khor los sgyur rib rnams 'dus nas 'khod par gyur pa 'khor dang bcas pa de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das la lta zhing ngo mtshar du gyur rmad du gyur dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla sgron ma de'i /smin mtshams kyi bar gyi mdzod spu 1 nas 'od zer gcig byung nas de shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyi khri 11byung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad 'od zer de'i 'od kyis shin tu khyab par snang bar gyur te/ ma pham pa 'di lta ste dper na/da ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di dag snang bar gyur pa bzhin no/ /ma pham pa yang de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs 'bring nan/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag nyi shu 'khod pa dang / 'khor de na chos nyan pa de dag 'od zer chen po'i snang ba des 'jig rten snang bar byas pa mthong nas ngo mtshar du gyur rmad du gyur te ltad mo cher byung ngo / /ma pham pa de'i tshe na yang bcom ldan 'das de'i 57—21

bstan pa la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od mchog ces bya ba byung ste de'i slob ma brgyad brgya yod do/ /bcom ldan 'das de yang ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs nas byang chub sems dpa' 'od mchog lasam1brtsams te/dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs yang dag par ston te/bar gyi bskal pa drug cu tsho tshang bar gdan gcig la bzhugs nas sku mi bskyod /sems mi g.yo bar bshad do/ /'khor de dag thams cad kyang stan gcig la 'khod de/ /lus mi bskyod 4sems mi g.yo bar bar gyi bskal pa drug cur 5bcom ldan 'das de la chos nyan te/ 'khor de na sems can 'ga' yang lus ngal ba yang med/ sems skyo 6ba yang med do / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla sgron mas bar gyi bskal pa drug cu na'adas kyi bar du/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs mdo sde shin tu rgyas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yongs su bzung 9)ba bshad nasal/ skad cig de nyid la mya ngan las 'da' 1 zhes lha dang bcas bdud dang bcas tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang dge sbyong dang bram zer bcaso pa'i skye dgu'i mdun du/ dge slong dag do mod nam gyi gung thun la de bzhin gshegs pa phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o zhes gsungs so/ /ma 1pham pa de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla sgron ma des/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpal gyi snying po zhes bya ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan nas 'khor 57—22

de dag thams cad la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi snying po 'di/ nga'i 51)'og tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub namangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dri ma med pa'i spyan zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /ma pham pa de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla lasgron ma de'i nub mo nam gyi gung thun la5/ phung po'i gye lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 7chen po 'od mchog des blangs te bar gyi bskal pa brgyad cu'i 8bar du/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das pa de'i bstan pa la yang dag par bstan to/ /ma pham pa de la bcom ldan 'das de'i sras blo gros la sogs pa brgyad po de dag byang chub sems dpa' 'od mchog de'i slob mar gyur te/ des de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas so/ /de dag gis de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po mthong ste/ bkur 9 ste byas nas de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ de dag gi tha ma ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad yin no/ /slob ma 11brgyad brgya po de dag las gcig rnyed pa la rab tu gdu ba bkur sti la gdu ba shes dkyi khe la gdu ba grags pa 'dod pas/ de la ribastan 7pa'i tshig dang ske/ yi ge mi zin mi chags te de'i ming yang grags 'dod ces bya bar gyur 51—23

to / /des kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba des sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po mnyes par byas so/ /mnyes par byas nas bste 1stang byas/ btsun par byas/ri mor byas/ mchod pa dang / bkur ba dang / rim gro byas so/ /ma pham pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ byang chub sems dpa' 'od mchog ces bya ba chos smra bar gyur pa de/ gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du khyod som nyi'am yid gnyis sam the tshom za bar gyur na de ltar mi blta'on/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kho bo de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' 'od mchog ces bya ba chos smra bar gyur to/ /gang yang byang chub sems dpa' grags 'dod ces bya ba le lo can du gyur pa de ni/ma pham pa khyod nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na/ byang chub sems dang/'a grags 'dod ces bya ba le lo can du gyur pa yin no/ /ma pham pa de ltar kho bos rnam grangs 'dis na bcom ldan 'das kyi snga ltas 'di lta bu'i 'od zer btang ba mthong nas / bcom ldan 'das kyang dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs mdo sde shin tu rgyas pa chen po de bshad par bzhed pa snyam byed do/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 4don de nyid rgyas par ston cing de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'das pa'i dus rnams rjes/ su dran pa ni//tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab bskal pa na/ /de tshe rgyal ba byung ba skye dgu'i mchog /mtshan ni nyi zla sgron ma zhes bya ba/ /skye dgu 'dren pa de ni chos ston te / /sems can mtha' yas bye ba rnam par 'dul/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsam yas bye ba stong / /mang po de dag ye shes yang dag 'dzud/ /rnam par 'dren pa gzhon nur gyur pa yi/ /de tshe de'i zhasras gyur brgyad tshopo dag /thub chen rab tu byung ba de mthong nas/ /'dod spangs thams cad myur bar rab tu 51—24

byung —/ /'jig rten mgon po de yi tsho1chos bshad pa/ /mtha' yas nges par bstan pa mdo sde mchog /de ming shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo zhes bya/ /srog chags stong phrag bye ba dag la ston/ /rnam par 'dren pa de yis bshadaman ma thag /de tshe skad cig skyil mo krung bcas nas/ /mtha' yas nges bstan ting 'dzin dam pa la/ /thub mchog chos gdan bzhugs nas bsam gtan mdzad/ /lha yi me tog man dā 5skur ba 'bab/ /ma brdungs par ni rnga yi sgra yang 'byung 4/ /lha dang gnod sbyin bar snang gnas 'khod pa/ /rkang gnyis dam pa la ni mchod pa byed / /zhing rnams thams cad de ma thag tu g.yos/ /de na ngo mtshar rmad du byung bar gyur/ /smin mtshams nas ni shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /'dren pas pa'od zer gcig po rab btang ba/ /shar gyi phyogs su 'od zer de song bas/ /zhing rnams stong phrag bcwa brgyad tshang ba dag /rab tu snang bas 'jig rten thams cad mdzes/ /sems can rnams kyi shi 'pho skye ba ston/ /rnam par 'dren pa'i 'od zer de yi mthus/ /de ltar de na la la rin chen zhing / /de bzhin kha dog bee drurya 6yi mdog /blta na sdug pa sna tshogs snang bar gyuran/ /lha dang mi dang de bzhin gnod sbyin klu/ /lha yi bu mo dri za mi 'am ci/ /gang rnams bde bar gshegs la mchod brtson pa/ /de dag 'jig rten khams na mchod byed snang —/ /sangs rgyas rang 'byung 9de dag nyid kyang snang / /gser gyi mchod sdong lta bur blta na sdug /bai drurya yi dbus na gser gzugs bzhin/ /'khor gyi dbus na chos ni rab tu gsung / /de na nyan thos grangs yod ma yin te/ /bde gshegs nyan thos de snyed tshad med pa/ /so so'i zhing du rnam par 'dren pa yi / /'od zer 'od kyis de dag thams cad ston/ /brtson 'grus ldan zhing 51—25

tshul khrims ma nyams te/ /tshul khrims skyon med nor bu rin chen 'dra/ /mi mgon sras dag ri yi sul dag na/ /gnas shing spyod pa de dag snang bar gyur41//bdog pa thams cad ma lus yongs su gtong / /brtan pa bzod pa'i stobs can bsam gtan dga'/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i bye snyed mang / /'od zer de yis thams cad rab tu snang / /bskyod 5pa med cing g.yo ba med par yang / /bzod nas bsam gtan dga' zhing mnyam par bzhag /de dag bsam gtan byang chub mchog zhugs pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi sras rnams snang / /yang dag zhi ba zag pa med pa'i gnas/ /shin tu shes nas yang dag rab ston te/ /'jig rten khams mang du ni chos kyang 'chad/ de 'dra'i byed pa ribader gshegs mthu yis byung / /nyi ma zla ba sgron com de yi 5mthus/ /skyong ba'i 'khor bzhis de dag mthong nas su/ /de tshe thams cad dga' bar gnas gyur te/ /'di ltar ci zhig ces 6ni phan tshun 'dri/ /gnod sbyin lha mis de mchod mi ring bar/ /'jig rten 'dren pa ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs/ /chos smra byang chub sems dpa' gang mkhas pa/ /'od mchog sras la de tshe 'di skad gsungs/ /mkhas pa khyod ni 'jig rten mig dang lam/ /nga yi 'os 'dzin shin tu yid brtan pas/ /ji ltar srog chags phan phyir ngas bshad pa/ /nga yi chos mdzod 'di la khyod mngon sum/ /byang chub sems dpa' mang po kun bkod de/ /dga' bar byas shing shin tu bsngags bstod nas/ /bar gyi bskal pa drug cu 7tshang bar ni/ /de tshe rgyal ba de yis chos mchog bshad/ /gdan gcig steng bzhugs 'jig rten mgon po des / /chos mchog dam pa dag ni gang bshad pa/ /de dag thams cad 'od mchog rgyal ba'i sras/ /chos smrar 57—26

gyur pa de yis shin tu bzungs 1tsho/ /rgyal ba des ni chos kyi mchog bshad de95/ /skye bo du ma rab tu dga' byas nas/ /de yi nyin par lhar bcas 'jig rten mdun / /rnam par 'dren pa de ni 'di skad gsung / /nga yis chos kyi tshul 'di rab bstan te/ /chos kyi rirang bzhin ci 'dra bshad zin gyis kyi/ /dge slong do nub nam gyi gung ra thun la/ /nga ni mya ngan 'da' ba'i dus la bab nga yi bstan pa 'di la rab sbyor la/ /bag med ma yin dad pa snying por gyis/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig 'das par yang / /rgyal ba drang srong chen po rnyed par dka' / /rkang gnyis dam pa shin tu myur ba ru/ /mya ngan las ni 'da' ba'i sgra thos nas/ sangs rgyas sras rnams mang po mya ngan skyes/ /sdug bsngal rab dang shin tu ldan par gyur/ /srog chags bsam yas bye mang de dag la/ /mi yi dbang po rgyal pos cadabugs phyung ba/ /mya ngan nga 'das dge slong ma 'jigs shig /nga yi 'og tu sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpal snying mkhas pa 'di/ /zag med ye shes 'di ni rtogs par rig /nga yi byang chub mchog rab 'thob na'agyur te/ /spyan dang yan lag dri med rgyal bar 'ong / /de tshe de skre nam gyi gung thun la/ /rgyu zad me dang 'dra bar mya ngan 'das/ /de yi sku gdung shin tu rgyas gyur te/ /mchod rten bye ba khrag khrig mtha' yas so/ /de na dge slong de bzhin dge slong ma/ /gang rnams byang chub mchog la rab zhugs shing / /bde gshegs de yi bstan la mngon brtson pa/ /de dag mi nyung gang gā'i bye ma snyed/ /de tshe chos smrar gang gyur dge slong ni/ /gang gis chos de bzung ba 'od mchog ste/ /bar gyi bskal pa brgyad cu 9tshang bar des/ /bskal pa de la chos mchog rab tu ston/ /de yi slob mar gyur pa brgyad brgya 51—27

dag /de dag thams cad yongs su smin par byas/ /de dag sangs rgyas bye ba mang po mthong / /drang srong chen po de dag bkur ste byas/ /de tshe spyad pa rjes su 'thun spyad nas1/ /'jig rten mang po khams su sangs rgyas gyur/ /gcig 'og gcig tu de dag rjes bzhin du/ /byang chub mchog tu gcig gis gcig lung bstan/ /sangs rgyas de dag rim gyis byung ba yi/ /tha mar gyur pa mar me mdzad pa ste/ /lha yi lha mchog drang srong mang po'i mchog /srog chags bye ba stong yang rnam par btul/ /gang sngon bde bar gshegs pa de yi sras/ /de yi tshe na 'od mchog chos smra ba'i/ /slob ma srid dang ldan zhing le lo can/ /shes kyi khe dang rnyed pa tshol ba dang / /shin tu grags pa 'dod pa'i shas che zhing / /grong nas grong du rgyu bar gyur pa ste/ /de yi kha ton 5lung nos de bzhin kun/ /de yi tshe na bshad pa rnams mi zin/ /de yi ming yang 'di zhes bya bar gyur/ /grags pa 'dod ces phyogs su rnam par grags/ /de yang dge ba rnams kyi las de dag /'dren mar gyur pa mngon par 'dus byas pas/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag bye ba mnyes byas te/ /de dag mchod pa rgya cher 3byas par gyur/ /rjes su 'thun pa'i spyod cang/ rab spyad nas/ /sangs rgyas shākya seng ge 'di yang mthong / /de ni 'dir yang tha mar byung ba ste/ /rjes bzhin byang chub mchog kyang 'thob 'gyur ba/ /byams pa'i rigs su bcom ldan 'das su 'gyur/ /srog chags stong phrag bye ba rnam par 'dul/ /bder gshegs mya ngan 'das pa'i bstan pa la / /de tshe le lo can du gang gyur pa/ /de na de 'drar gyur pa khyod nyid do/ /de tshe chos smrar gyur pa kho bo ste/ /kho bos de dang de yi rgyu dang bzhis / /ye shes grags pa de yi ltas byung ba/ /sngon tshe de na kho bos mthong gyur pa/ /de 57—28

'dra'i ltas 'di deng yang mthong bas na/ /nges par rgyal ba'i dbang po kun tu spyan / /shākya'i rgyal chen don dam gzigs pas kyang / /de tshe kho bos rnam grangs mchog thos gang / /de dag nyid ni 'dis kyang bshad par dgongs/ /de yi ltas nyid de ring yongs rdzogs kyis(17/ /rnam par 'dren pa rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa/ /shākya seng ge yang dag 'jog mdzad de/ /chos kyi dngos 5nyid phyag rgya ston par 'gyur/ /thal mo sbyar te sems bzang brtson par gyis/ /'jig rten phan zhing thugs brtse ston gyur te/ /mtha' yas pa yi chos kyi char pa 'babaca/ /gang dag byang chub phyir zhugs ngoms par mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub phyir 5zhugs pa/ /gang dag mkhas pa nyid las skyes gyur pa / /de dag rnams kyi som nyi gang yin dang / /yid gnyis the tshom gang yin de sel gyur/ /dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs las/gleng gzhi'i le'u zhes bya tsiste dang po'o// //7bam po gnyis pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dran pa dang ldan zhing mkhyen bzhin du ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs so/ /bzhengs nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri dwa ta'i 8bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs su chud pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni zab pa mthong bar dka' ba rtogs par dka' ba ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis shes par dka'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po la bsnyen bkur 57—29

mdzad mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod pa spyad spyad pa/ yun ring po nas rjes su zhugs pa/ brtson 'grus mdzad mdzad pa ste/ ngo mtshar dang rmad du byung ba'i chos dang ldan zhing shes par dka' ba'i chos rnams mkhyen pa'i phyir ro/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ldem por dgongs te bshad pa ni shes par dka'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rang gis terig pa'i chos rnams thabs mkhas pa dang / ye shes mthong ba dang / rgyu dang / gzhi dang / dmigs pa dang / nges pa'i tshig dang /rnam par rig byed sna tshogs rnams nakyis yang dag par ston te/ thabs mkhas pa de dang de dag gis sems can de dang de la chags pa rnams rab tu 'grel pa'i phyir ro/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni thabs mkhas pa chen po dang / ye shes mthong ba dam pa'i pha rol tu byon lapa'o/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni/ chags pa med cing thogs pa med pa'i ye shes mthong ba dang / stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang ma 'drel pa dang dbang po dang stobs dang byang chub kyi yan lag dang bsam gtan dang /rnam par thar pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rmad du byung ba'i chos dang ldan te/ chos rnam pa sna tshogs yang dag par ston pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni ngo mtshar chen po brnyes 5pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu de tsam gyis bshad pa chog tshopar gyis shig /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag 57—30

par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni ngo mtshar mchog brnyes0)pa ste/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas chos gang mkhyen pa'i chos de yang de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la 'chad do/ /shā ri'i bu chos thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa nyid ston to/ /chos thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen te chos de dag gang yin pa dang / chos de dag ji lta bu yin pa dang /chos de dag ci 'dra ba dang / chos de dag gi namatshan nyid gang yin pa dang /chos de dag gi ngo bo nyid ci yin pa dang / chos de dag gang yin pa dang / ji lta bu yin pa dang ci 'dra ba dang / mtshan nyid gang yin pa dang ngo bo nyid ci yin pa yang mkhyen to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don de nyid rgyas par ston cing de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /lha mir bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /dpa' bo chen po dpag med pa/ /rnam 'dren sems can thams cad kyis/ /rnam pa kun tu shes mi nus/ /de dag stobs dang rnam thar dang / /'jigs med gang dag ci 'dra dang / /sangs rgyas chos rnams ci 'dra ba/ sus kyang shes par mi nus so/ /sangs rgyas bye ba'i gan shurnyidag na/ /zab cing shin tu phra ba dang / /rig dka' mthong bar dka' ba yi/ /spyod pa dag ni sngan canachad bsnyen/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /spyod pa de dag spyad pa yi/ /'bras bu de ni ci 'dra ba/ /byang chub snying por ngas mthong ngo /de ni 'jig rten rnam 'dren pa/ /gzhan dag dang mu ni ngas kyang de/ /ci lta yin dang ci 'dra dang / /de yi mtshan nyid ci 'dra shes/ /de ni bstan du mi nus te/ /de ni brjod du yong med do/ /mos pa la ni gang gnas pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogs par/ /gang la chos de bstan pa dang / /bstan 51—31

pa dag kyang shes pa yi/ de 'dra'i 1)sems can su yang ni/ /'jig rten dag na yod ma yin/ /gang dag 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i nyan thos pa/ /lhag par byas pa bde bar gshegs pas bsngags/ /zag zad tha ma'i lus 'dzin de dag gi / /yul ni rgyal ba'i ye shes 'di la med/ /gal te 'jig rten de dag thams cad du/ /shā ri'i bu dang 'dra bas gang gyur te/ /gcig tu 'dus par gyur nas rnam 2bsams kyang / /de dag bder gshegs ye shes shes mi nus/ /gal te khyod dang 'dra ba'i mkhas rnams kyis/ /phyogs rnams bcu car dgang bar gyur pa cadang / /gang yang nga yi nyan thos 'di gzhan rnams/ /de dag gis kyang de bzhin gang gyur te/ /de dag thams cad gcig tu deng 'dus nas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes rnam rabasams kyang / /ji tsam tshad med ye shes ngas shes pa/ /thams cad 'dus pas shes par mi nus so/ /zag pa med par gyur pa'i rang sangs rgyas/ /dbang po rno ba tha ma'i lus 'dzin pas/ /ji ltar snyig yidang 'dam bu'i tshal bzhin du/ /phyogs bcu thams cad gang bar gyur pa dag /gcig tu 'dus nas rnam par bsams byas kyang / /nga yi chos kyi mchog gi phyogs tsam yang / /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mtha' yas su/ /de yi yang dag don ni yong mi shes/ /byang chub sems dpa' theg par gsar 7zhugs pa / /sangs rgyas bye ba mang la bya ba byas/ /shin tu nges don chos smra mang po rnamasal/ /de dag gis kyang phyogs bcu gang gyur te/ /sbyig nadang 'dam bu bzhin du 'jig rten kun/ /bar mtshams med par rtag tu gang gyur la/ /gcig tu 'dus nas rnam par sems byed cing / /shes rab phra bas gzhan du mi sems par/ /bskal pa bye ba mang po dpag med pa/ /gang gā'i bye ma snyed du 57—32

bsam ga1/byas kyang / /chos gang bde bar gshegs pas mngon gzigs pa/ /'di la de dag rnams kyi yul med do/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang ske/ /mi nyung gang gā'i bye ma snyed rnams kyis/ /gzhan du mi sems rnam par bsams 5byas kyang / /'di la de 3dag gi yang yul med do/ /zab cing shin tu phra ba'i chos rtogs shing / /rtog pa med la thams cad zag med pa/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rgyal ba de dag dang / /ngas ni 'di na de dag ci 'dra shes/ /gzhan min gsung ba rgyal ba drang srong che/ /yun ring dus na mchog gi don 'chad kyis / /bde bar gshegs pas gang bstan de la ni/ /mos pa phun sum tshogs byos rashā ri'i bu/ /nyan thos pa ni 'di dag thams cad dang / /rang sangs rgyas su mi gang zhugs pa dang / /mya ngan 'das la ngas ni gang bkod cing ske/ /sdug bsngal rgyud las yang dag dgrol la bsgo6/ /gang phyir 'jig rten du ni chos mang bshad/ /de dang de la chags pa rab dgrol 7zhing / /theg pa gsum dag nye bar bstan pa ni/ /de dag nga yi thabs mkhas mchog yin no/ /de nas 'khor de na kun shes kauṇḍi nan la sogs pa nyan thos chen po gang dag dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa dbang dang ldan par gyur pa stong nyis brgya dang /gzhan yang gang dag nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma dag dang / gang yang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la zhugs pa de dag thams cad 'di snyam du sems te/bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa cher bsngags pa dang / chos zab mo de yang mngon par rdzogs par 9sangs rgyas so zhes gsung zhing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis shes par 51—33

dka'o zhes gsungs pa'i 15rgyu ni gang / gzhi ni ci zhig /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis narnam par grol ba gcig go/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /bdag cag rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams rnyed par 'gyur zhing mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa yin mod kyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas de'i don bdag cag gis ma rig go snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'khor bzhi po de dag som nyi dang the tshom za bar rig ste sems kyi rnam par rtogs pa)pa sems kyis shes nas/ bdag nyid kyang chos la the tshom za bar gyur te de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa mkhyen pa'i chos bstan pa yang dang yang bsngags pa mdzad pa dang / chos zab mo ngas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes bgyi ba dang / ldem por dgongs te bshad pa yang shes par dka'o zhes yang dang yang gsungs pa'i 5rgyu gang lags rkyen gang lags / bdag gis bcom ldan 'das las 6chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lta bu sngonas7chad ma thos te/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi po 'di dag kyang the tshom dang som nyi 'tshal na/ de bzhin gshegs pas ci la dgongs te de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos zab mo yang dang yang gsung ba na mdzad pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par bshad du gsol/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /stobs dang rnam thar bsam gtan dag /dpag tu med pa ngas thob ces/ /ring nas mi yi nyi ma yis/ /deng gdong bka' 9mchid 'di 1 'dra mdzad/ /khyod la zhu ba ma mchis par/ /byang chub snying po'ang brjod pa mdzad/ /khyod la su yang mi zhu bar/ /ldem por dgongs 57—34

te bshad pa brjod/ /ma zhus par ni gsung mdzad de/ /nyid kyi spyod pa bsngags pa mdzad/ /ye shes brnyes pa brjod mdzad cing / /zab mo dag kyang rab bshad pas/ /dbang ldan gyur cing zag med pa/ /mya ngan 'das par gang bzhugs 3)rnams/ /rgyal ba ci zhig gsung snyam ste/ /de ring (gyi'adi dag the tshom 'gyuras)/ /rang rgyal byang chub gang 'tshal ba/ /dge slong de bzhin dge slong ma/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /lto 'phye ( riche dang dri za dag /the tshom 'tshal zhing rnam sems te/ /de dag phan tshun gtam mchi 5)zhing / /rkang gnyis mchog la rab blta (6na/ /thub pa chen po lung bstan gsol/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams/ /'di na ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /de yi nang na bdag mchog ces/ /drang srong mchog gis bstan lags na/ /mi yi gtso bo nyid kyi gnas/ /'di la bdag kyang the tshom 'tshal/ /mya ngan 'das mthar bdag phyin 57tam/ /'on te bdag la spyod bstan tam/ /rnga mchog dbyangs kyis rab tu gsung phyung ste/ /chos 'di ji lta lags pa bshad du gsol/ /rgyal sras thugs sras mchis pa 'di dag rnams/ /thal mo sbyar bar bgyis nas rgyal la lta/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin srin por bcas/ /bye ba stong phrag gang gā'i bye ma snyed/ /byang chub mchog 'di 'tshal ba gang lags pa/ /brgyad khri tshang bar gang mchis de dag dang / /sa bdag 'khor los sgyur dunaraba'i rgyal po gang / /bye ba stong gi zhing nas lhags pa dag /spyod pa ji ltar yongs su rdzogs bgyi zhes//thams cad thal mo sbyar te gus par mchis/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu don 'di bshad pas ci zhig bya/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu don 51—35

'di bshad na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di phyogadangangs par 'gyur ro/ /yang tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la lan gnyis su gsol ba btab pa/ don 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bshad du gsol/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'di na srog chags brgya phrag mang po/ srog chags stong phrag mang po/ srog chags brgya stong phrag mang po/ srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gomang po sngon gyi sangs rgyas mthong ba shes rab dang ldan pa gang dag /bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa la dad pa dang yid ches pa dang 'dzin par 'gyur ba mchis so / /de nas de'i tshe 5)tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsol to / /srog chags stong rnams 'khor na mchis pa dag /dad dga' bde bar gshegs la gus pa ste/ /khyod kyis rme tshochos bstan de dag 'tshal bar 'gyur/ /mi dbang rgyal po gsal 5bar bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la lan gnyis su yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu don 'di bshad pas ci zhig bya/ shā ri'i bu don 'di bshad na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'di dngangs par 'gyur te/ dge slong lhag pa'i nga rgyal can du gyur pa rnams g.yang sa chen por lhung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /nga yi chos 'di bshad pas chog /ye shes 'di phra brtag 6mi nus/ /byis pa mang 'khod nga rgyal can/ /nga yis chos bshad mi shes spong / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum du yang gsol ba btab pa don 'di nyid/bcom ldan 'das bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bshad du gsol/’ 1—36

bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'di na bdag dang 'dra ba brgya phrag mang du mchis so /bcom ldan 'das srog chags brgya phrag mang po srog chags stong phrag mang po srog chags brgya stong phrag mang po 1srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po dag bcom ldan 'das sngon gyi srid pa dag na yongs su smin par mdzad pa nagazhan dag kyang mchis te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa la dad par 'gyur yid ches par 'gyur 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de yang de dag gi yun ring po'i don dang sman pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog gis chos bshad gsol/ /khyod la sras kyi thu bo bdag gsol pa/ /'di na srog chags bye ba stong mchis pa/ /de dag khyod kyis chos bshad 'di dad 'gyur/ /sngon gyi srid pa rnams su khyod kyis gang / /yun ring rtag tu sems can smin mdzad pa/ /de kun thal mo sbyar te 'di na mchis/ /de dag chos 'di la ni dad param 'gyur/ /bdag 'dra brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'di dag dang / /gang dag byang chub mchog tu zhugs pa dag /de la gzigs nas bde gshegs rab bshad de/ /de dag dga' ba mchog kyang bskyed du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus lan gsum cagasol ba btab pa ci mkhyen nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa la lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba 'debs na / shā ri'i bu de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa la khyod 'a ji skad byas/ shā ri'i bu de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig 6)dang ngas khyod la bshad do / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' nastsal ma thag tu/ 'khor de 51—37

nas dge slong dang dge slong ma dang dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma lhag pa'i nga rgyal can lnga stong stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 37la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nanas 'khor de nas dong ngo / /'di ltar lhag pa'i nga rgyal gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba ma thob par ni thob par 'du shes/ khong du ma chud par ni khong du chud par 'du shes pa de dag rang gi skyon shes te/ 'khor de nas dong ba la bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bar gyur pas gnang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu nga'i 'khor shin te ma med par gyur te/ shā ri'i bu snying po ma yin pa med par gyur la dad pa'i snying po la gnas te lhag pa'i nga rgyal can de' dag dong ba yang legs so/ /shā ri'i bu de lta bas na de'i don bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol nas/ shā ri'i bu bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i 4bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni brgya la res 'ga' zhig 'di lta bu'i chos bstan pa gsung ngo ske/ /'di lta ste dper na/ u dum bā para'i tshal la me tog ni brgya la res 'ga' 'byung ngo / /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du de bzhin phyogashegs pa yangalo7brgya la res 'ga' zhig nachos bstan pa 'di lta bu 9gsung ngo / /shā ri'i bu nga la yid ches par gyis shig nga ni bden par smra ba'o/ /nga ni yang dag par smra ba'o/ /nga ni gzhan ma yin par smra ba'o/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i ldem por dgongs te bshad pa'i don khong du chud par dka'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i 1 bu ngas nges pa'i tshig dang bstan pa dang brjod pa dang dpe sna tshogs dang thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa brgya stong dag gis chos rab tu bshad pa ni brtag 11tu 57—38

med cing rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir te/ shā ri'i bu chos de ni de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen par bya ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu bya ba gcig dang byed pa gcig dang bya ba chen po dang byed pa chen po'i phyir/ bya ba gang dang byed pa gang gis 1)de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i bya ba gcig po dang byed pa gcig po dang bya ba chen po dang byed pa chen po dang bya ba gang dang byed pa gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba gang zhe na/ de ni sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba yang dag par 'dzin du gzud pa'i rgyu'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ngo / /sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba yang dag par bstan pa'i rgyu'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ngo / /sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba la zhugs pa'i rgyu'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ngo / /sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba khong du chud par bya ba'i rgyu'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ngo / /sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba'i lam du gzud pa'i nargyu'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ste/ shā ri'i bu de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bya ba 51—39

gcig po dang byed pa gcig po dang bya ba chen po dang byed pa chen po dang 'jig rten du 'byung ba'i dgongs pa gcig pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas bya ba gcig po dang byed pa gcig po dang bya ba chen po dang byed pa chen po de 1de bzhin gshegs pas mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu nga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa'o//shā ri'i bu nga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba yang dag par ston pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu nga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba la 'jug par byed pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu nga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba khong du chud par byed pa'o2ske/ /shā ri'i bu nga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba'i lam la 'dzud pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu nga yang theg pa gcig las brtsams te sems can rnams la chos ston pa 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi theg pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar thug pa ste/ theg pa gnyis sam gsum zhes bya ba gang yang med do ske/ /shā ri'i bu phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na yang chos nyid ni 'di'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag 'das pa'i dus na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med grangs med pa rnams su byung ste/ sems can mos pa tha dad pa dang khams dang bsam pa tha dad pa rnams kyi bsam pa mkhyen nas skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / skye bo phal po che dang lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir sna tshogs mngon par bsgrub pa bstan pa dang rgyu dang gzhi dang dpe dang dmigs pa dang nges pa'i tshig dang thabs la rimakhas pa rnam pa sna 57—40

tshogs kyis chos bstan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyang ske/ shā ri'i bu theg pa gcig las 1brtsams nas sems can rnams la chos bstan te de yang 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi theg pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar thug pa ste/ gang 'di sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid yang dag par 'dzin du 'dzud pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid ston pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid la 'jug par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid 5khong du chud par byed pa/ sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid kyi lam du 'jug par byed pa'i chos ston te/ shā ri'i bu 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag las sems can gang dag gis chos de thos pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par gyur to/ /shā ri'i bu ma 'ongs pa'i dus na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med grangs med pa rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag 'byung bske/ sems can mos pa tha dad pa dang bsam pa cadang khams tha dad pa rnams kyi bsam pa mkhyen nas/ skye bo mang po la phan pa dang skye bo rimang po la bde ba dang 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang skye bo phal po che dang lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir sna tshogs mngon par bsgrub pa bstan pa dang rgyu dang gzhi dang dpe dang dmigs pa dang nges pa'i tshig dang thabs mkhas pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis chos ston par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyang / shā ri'i bu theg pa gcig las sgyu brtsams nas sems can 51—41

rnams la chos ston par 'gyur te/ de yang 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi theg pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar thug pa ste/ gang 'di sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid ston pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid la 'jug par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid khong du chud par byed pa/ sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid kyi lam du 'jug par byed pa'i chos ston par 'gyur te/ shā ri'i bu ma 'ongs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag las sems can gang dag chos nyan pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu da ltar byung ba'i dus na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med grangs med pa dag na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes 1pa/ sems can mos pa tha dad pa dang khams dang bsam pa tha dad pa rnams kyi bsam pa mkhyen nas/skye bo mang po la phan pa dang skye bo mang po la bde ba dang 'jig rten la snying brtse /ba dang skye bo phal po che dang lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir sna tshogs mngon par bsgrub pa bstan pa dang rgyu dang gzhi dang dpe dang dmigs pa dang nges pa'i tshig nadang / thabs mkhas pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyang / shā ri'i bu theg pa gcig las brtsams nas sems can rnams la chos ston te/ de yang 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi theg pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar thug pa ste/51—42

gang 'di sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid ston pa / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid la 'jug par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid khong du chud par byed pa/ sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid kyi lam du 'jug par byed pa'i chos ston te/ shā ri'i bu da ltar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag las/ sems can gang dag chos nyan pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nga hu)yang sems can mos pa tha dad pa dang khams dang bsam pa tha dad pa rnams kyi bsam pa mkhyen nas/ skye bo mang po la phan pa dang skye bo mang po la bde ba dang 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang skye bo phal po che dang lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ sna tshogs mngon par bsgrub pa bstan pa dang rgyu dang gzhi dang dpe dang dmigs pa dang nges pa'i tshig dang thabs mkhas pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis chos 2)ston to/ /shā ri'i bu nga yang theg pa gcig las dzubartsams nas sems can rnams la chos ston te/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi theg pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar thug pa ste/ gang 'di'i sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid ston pasnin / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid la 'jug par byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid khong du chud par byed pa/ sems can 51—43

rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nyid kyi lam du 'jug par byed pa'i chos ston te/ shā ri'i bu sems can gang dag da ltar nga nyu)la 'di ltar chos nyan pa de padag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu rnam grangs 'dis kyang 'di ltar rig par bya ste/'di ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gang na yang theg pa gnyis su gdags pa yang med na gsum du lta ga la yod/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nam bskal pa'i snyigs ma las cabyung ngam sems can gyi snyigs ma'am/ nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma'am/ lta ba'i snyigs ma'am / tshe'i snyigs ma las 5byung na/ shā ri'i bu 'di lta bur bskal pa dang 'khrul pa'i snyigs ma dang dri ma mang po dang brkam pa'i sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ba de'i tshe/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams thabs mkhas pas sangs rgyas kyi theg pa gcig po de las theg pa gsum du bshad de bstan to/ /shā ri'i bu de ltar gang nyan thos sam dgra bcom pa'am rang sangs rgyas rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i bya ba sangs rgyas kyi theg pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa la 6mi nyan mi 'jug khong du chud par mi byed pa de dag ni/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos ma yin par rig tshar bya'o/ /dgra bcom pa yang ma yin rang sangs rgyas kyang ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /shā ri'i bu yang dge slong ngam dge slong ma la la dgra bcom par khas 'che zhing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam yongs su mi 'dzin te/ nga ni sangs rgyas kyi theg pa bcad pa'o zhes zer zhing nga'i lus 'di tha ma mya ngan las 'da' ba'o zhes zer ba ni/ shā ri'i bu de 51—44

lhag pa'i nga rgyal can du shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu dge slong dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa de91/ de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum du gyur te/ chos 'di thos nas dad par mi 'gyur ba'i go skabs med cing gnas ma yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa g.yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa ni ma gtogs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de'i tshe/ mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di 'dzin pa'am 'chang ba'i lde nyan thos mi 'byung ste/ shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan lasam chos 'di la the tshom med par 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu nga la dad par gyis shig yid ches par gyis shig rtogs par gyis 5)shig shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la brdzun ri tshodu smra ba med de/ shā ri'i bu theg pa 'di ni 7gcig tu zad de 'di lta ste sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das don de nyid rgyas par ston cing de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /nga rgyal can gyi dge slong dang / /dge slong ma dang dge bsnyen dang / /dge bsnyen ma rnams ma dad pa/ /lnga stong las ni mi nyung ba/ /bslab pa zhig ral 8ldan pa rnams/ /nyes pa 'di 49dag mthong gyur nas/ /skyon rnams yongs su sbed 1 pa'i phyir/ /byis pa'i blo can de dag dong 11/ /gang gis chos 'di nyan par 'gyur ba yi/ /de dag la ni dge ba de med 12de/ /'khor gyi snyigs ma nyid du mkhyen nas su/ /'jig rten mgon po ngas kyang bstsal 12ba yin/ /nga yi 'khor ni legs par 'khod/ /shun 1 pa med cing dag pa ste/ /snying po ma yin kun med gyur15/ /'di dag snying po rab tu gnas/ /skyes bu dam 17pa skyob pa sangs rgyas dag /thabs la mkhas pa brgya phrag du ma 51wa 45

yis / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos ni ci gsung ba/ /ci 'dra nga la nyon cig shā ri'i bu/ /de dag spyod pa bsam pa ci 'dra'ang mkhyen/ /srog chags bye ba mos pa tha dad pa/ /de dag sngon chad dge ba ci byas dang / /las rnams sna tshogs dag ni mkhyen nas su/ /nges pa'i tshig dang gzhi rnams sna tshogs kyis/ /srog chags de dag khong du chud par byed/ /ngas ni rgyu dang dpe yang brgya dag gis/ /sems can de lta de ltar mgu bar byas/ /mdo sde de bzhin tshigs su bcad pa'ang bshad/ /de ltas(1)byung dang skyes rabs rmad byung dang / /gleng gzhi dedzababazhin gtan la dbab pa dang / /dbyangs bsnyadastobadape brgya sna tshogs rnams kyis bshad/ /mi mkhas gang dag dman la mngon dga' zhing / /sangs rgyas bye ba mang la spyod ma spyad/ /'khor bar chags shing shin tu sdug bsngal ba/ /de la mya ngan 'da' ba nye bar bstan/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rab tu rtogs bya'i9)phyir / /da ltar rang byung ba ni thabs mdzad de/ /khyed cag 5)sangs rgyas su yang 'grub bo zhes/ /de rnams la ni re shig 6)mi gsung ngo / /ci'i57)phyir zhe na skyob pa dus la bzhes / /dal ba gzigs te de nas gdod 9)'chad do/ /dal ba de ni brgya la deng thob pas/ /de phyir yang dag nges pa 'dir bshad do/ snye /nga yi bstan pa yan lag dgu po yang / /sems can dag gi mthu dang stobs las bshad / /'di ltar thabs kyis mchog sbyin ye shes la/ /rab tu gzud pa'i phyir ni ngas bshad do/ /gang dag rtag tu rnam par dag gyur pa/ /gsal gtsang rab tu des pa sangs rgyas sras/ /sangs rgyas bye ba mang la lhag byas pa/ /de dag la ni rab rgyas mdo rnams bshad/ /'di ltar de dag bsam pa rdzogs pa dang ske/ /rnam par dag pa'i tshul dang ldan gyur pa/ /de dag la ni ma 'ongs 57—46

dus na yang / /phan zhing brtse ba'i sangs rgyas 'gyur zhes gsung / /thos nas 'gro mchog sangs rgyas 'gyur snyam ste/ /thams cad shin tu dga' bas khyab par 'gyur / /de dag spyod pa rnams kyang ngas shes nas/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde rab tu bshad/ /'di ltar 'dren pa'i nyan thos de dag las6)/ /gang dag nga yisaskrubastan pa 'di thos pa/ /tshigs bcad gcig tsam thos sam bzung yang rung ske/ /thams cad the tshom med par byang chub 'gyur/ /theg pa tha dad par ni gang ston pa/ /skyes mchog rnams kyi thabs mkhas ma gtogs par/ /theg pa gcig ste gnyis su yod ma yin/ /'jig rten na ni nam yang gsum du med/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes bstan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten du yang 'jig rten mgon po byung / /bya ba gcig ste gnyis su yod ma yin/ /sangs rgyas theg pa dman pas mi 'dren to/ /rang 'byungadza bdag nyid cing la gnas pa dang / /sangs rgyas ji lta bu dang ci 'dra ba/ /stobs dang bsam gtan rnam thar dbang po rnams/ /de dag nyid la sems can rab tu 'jog /byang chub rdul med dam pa thob nas su/ /theg pa dman la sems can gcig bkod na/ /'di ni nga yi legs pa ma yin te/ /ser sna'i nyes pa'ang nga la yod par 'gyur/ /nga la ser sna dag ni cung zad med/ /nga la phrag dog med cing 'dod chags med/ /sdig pa'i chos rnams thams cad ngas bshad 5de/ /de phyir 'gro ba rtogs pas nga sangs rgyas/ /ji ltar mtshan rnams kyis ni nga brgyanas6)te/ /'jig rten 'di dag thams cad rab snang byed/ /srog chags brgya phrag du mas mdun bltas shing ske/ /chos kyi rang bzhin phyag rgya 'di bshad do/ /nga ni 'di snyam sems te shā ri'i bu/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi ri rigazugs ldan zhing / /bdag 'od 51—47

rang byung 'jig rten rig par yang / /de ltar ci nas sems can kun 'gyur snyam / /ji ltar mthong zhing ji ltar bsams pa dang / /nga yis snganasanyu)chad ji ltar brnags pa den/ /nga yi smon lam de dag yongs rdzogs te/ /byang chub sangs rgyas nas ni ma bstan to/ /sermes can rnams la byang chub 'dun skyed ces / /ngas ni de skad smras na shā ri'i bu/ /mi shes sems can rnams ni 'dir myos te/ /nga yi legs bshad 'dzin par gzhar mi 'gyur/ /de dag 'di 'dra'i tshul du ngas shes te/ /tshe rabs snga mar spyod pa rnams ma spyad(da/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnams la chags shing zhen/ /sred pas brgyal 4zhing gti mug myos pa rnams/ /de dag 'dod rgyus ngan 'gror rab tu ltung / /'gro ba drug tu kun 5tu nyon mongs te/ /dur khrod de dag phyi phyir 'phel bar byed/ /bsod nams chung bas 6sdug bsngal kun gyis gzir/ /lta ba'i thibs por rtag tu rnam par chags/ /yod dang med dang de bzhin yod med pa/ /ltar gyur drug cu 7gnyis la brten nas su/ /dngos po med la yongs su 'dzin cing gnas / /sbyang 8bar dka' zhing log byed nga rgyal can/ /byis pa thos nyung yon po g.yo byed rnams/ /tshe rabs bye ba phrag stong nam du yang / /de dag sangs rgyas sgra 'di mi thos so/ /nga yi thabs kyis de la shā ri'i bu/ /sdug bsngal mthar phyung 9shig ces de skad rmas1 / /sems can sdug bsngal gzir ba mthong bas na/ /de dag mya ngan 'das pa nye bar bstan/ /'di ltar ngas ni chos rnams 'di dag kun/ /gdod nas rab zhi mya ngan rtag 'das bshad/ /sangs rgyas sras de spyod pa kun rdzogs nas/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe la rgyal bar 'gyur/ /theg pa gsum du gang rnams bstan pa ni/ /nga yi thabs mkhas tshul ni de 'dra 57—48

ste / /theg pa gcig ste de bzhin tshul yang gcig /de ltar 'dren pa rnams kyis bshad pa gcig /gang 'dir la la the tshom yod pa dag /the tshom za dang de bzhin som nyi spongs/ /gzhan du mi gsung 'jig rten 'dren pa rnams/ /theg pa 'di ni gcig ste gnyis su med/ /sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa gang byung 1bske/ /sangs rgyas stong ngam mya ngan yongs 'das shing / /'das pa'i dus na bskal pa grangs med la/ /gang dag tshad ni nam yang yong med pa/ /skyes bu dam pa de dag thams cad kyis/ /dpe dang gzhi dang rgyu dang bcas pa dang / /thabs la mkhas pa brgya phrag du ma yis/ /rnam par dag pa'i chos rnams rab bshad pa/ /de dag thams cad theg pa gcig ston cing / /srog chags stong phrag bye ba bsam yas rnams/ /theg pa gcig po la yang rab 'dzud de/ /theg pa gcig la yongs su smin par byed/ /mos dang de bzhin bsam pa rnams mkhyen nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pas lhar bcas 'jig rten du/ /rgyal ba'i thabs gzhan rnam pa mang po dag /gang gis chos mchog 'di ni rab bstan pa/ /sems can gang gis de las namangon sum der/ /chos nyan pa dang 'on te thos ldan pa/ /sbyin pa sbyin zhing tshul khrims spyod pa dang / /bzod pas spyod pa thams cad bsgrubs dpa dang / /brtson 'grus bsam gtan lhag par byas pa dang ske/ /shes rab kyis ni chos 'di rnam cabasams te/ /rnam pa tha dad bsod nams sus byas pa/ /de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyal ba de dag gi/ /bstan pa de la sems can gang zhugs te/ /de na bzod cing zhi la dul ba ni/ /de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa de dag gi/ /rgyal ba'i ring bsrel 5dag la su mchod 51—49
