su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di/lus la thogs sam glegs bam du bgyis te 'dzin pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de bsod nams ji snyed cig skyed par 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sman gyi rgyal po rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gang gā'i klung brgyad cu'i 1bye ma snyed la bsti 2stang du byed/ btsun par byed/ ri mor byed/mchod par 5byed na/ sman gyi rgyal po 'di ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de gzhi de las bsod nams mang du skyed dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mang lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sman gyi rgyal po khyod mos par bya'o/ /khong du chud par bya'o/ /sman gyi rgyal po rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las/ tha na tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / nan tan gyis bsgrub can/ sman gyi rgyal po rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de gzhi de las de bas ches bsod nams mang du skyed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lus la thogs sam glegs bam du bgyis te/ 'dzin pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de bdag gis bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba ba'i slad 51—348

du gzungs sngags kyi tshig rnams stsal bar bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ abhya/ mkhye/ma 1ne ma ma ne/ tsiste tsa ri tsho te/ sha me sha ma 3yi la tā pabi / shādhe / muste / mukta 48ta me/ sa me a bi/ sha me 9sa ma sa me/ dza ye/ kṣa ye/ a kṣa ye/ akṣi ḍi1 / shārnye71/ sha mi te 12ṅgā ra khyi1na/ ā lo ka bhā se/ pra 1 tya bekṣa ṇi gi/ bi bi ru a bhyanta ra ṇi/ bisne/ a tyanta/ pa sari shud dhi/ ud ku lo17/ mud ku 1 le/ ar ḍi/ pa ra ḍi/ shu kā kṣi19/ a sa ma sa me/bud dha bi lo kite/ dharma pa rī kṣi te/ sang gha ni 2 ra gho 21ga ṇi na/ ni ra gho ṣa ṇi lha/ bha yā bha da ya/ sho dha ni marnye marnga/ kṣa ya tre/ ru dra kau sha phye/ a kṣa ye/ a kṣu/ ba na tā yā pa lo ri/ a man+ya na tā ya tsho/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung drug cu'i 3 bye ma snyed kyis bshad pa ste/ gang gis mdo sde 'di lta bu 'dzin pa chos smra ba 'di lta bu de dag dang 'gal bar bgyis na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad la de 'khus pa lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi rgyal po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sman gyi rgyal po khyod kyis gzungs sngags kyi tshig rnams smras pas / sems can mang po'i 29don byas shing sman gyi rgyal po sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir bsrung ba dang bskyab rdo pa dang sba ba byas pa legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu sbyin pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang / chos smra ba 'di lta bu dag gi ched du gzungs sngags kyi tshig 1rnams stsal bar bgyi ste/ des chos smra ba 'di lta bu de 51—349

dag la glags lta ba gang gisakyang glags mi rnyed pa 'di lta ste/ gnod sbyin nam/srin po'am/ srul po'am/ gshed byed dam/ grul bum mamatsho)/ yi dgas glags lta ba rnams kyis glags mi rnyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu sbyin pas de'i tshe gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag smras so/ /tarya thā/ dzale/ ma hā dzwa le/ sukki/ mukki(5)/ a ḍi a ḍa ba til/ dzra bye mṛ ṭwā dab ti/ iṭi ni/ birtsi/ tsirtsi ni/ dzra ṭa ṭi ni/ dzra ṭa ṭu ba ti swā hā tsho/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcomapa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis gsungs shing rjes su yi rang ba ste/ gang gis chos smra ba 'di lta bu 'di dag dang 'gal bar bgyis na/ de de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la 'khus pa lagasaso/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang chos smra ba de dag la glo ba brtse bas sman pa dang / bde ba dang / bsrung ba dang ske/ bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i slad du gzungs sngags kyi tshig rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ aṭa ṭa/ naṭa ṭi/ ta naṭa ṭi/ a na te nā ti/ku na ṭi swā hā5/ bcomaldan 'das gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag gis chos smra ba de dag la dpag tshad brgya tshun chad dus6)bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo mdo sde 'di lta bu 'dzin cing / chos smra ba de dag la yang bsrung ba bgyis par 'gyur/ bde legs su bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po chen po 'phagasaskyes po dri za bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas/ 'khor der 'dus par gyur te/ 'dug pa 51wa 350

de stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar 1te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugasamananas bcom ldan 'das rig la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang mdo sde 'di lta bu 'dzin pa/ chos smra ba 'di lta bu de dag bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i slad du gzungs sngags kyi tshig rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ /tabya thā/ a ga ṇi ga ṇi/ gi ri/ gan dha ri/tsaṇḍa li/ ma tang gi/ puka ka si/ sang ku le/ bru ṣa lī swā hā / bcom ldan 'das gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bzhi bcu rtsa 5gnyis kyis gsungs te/ gang zhig chos smra ba 'di lta bu de cadag dang 'gal bar bgyid na/ de dag thams cad la 'khus pa lags so/ /de nas srin mo 'phyang ma zhes bya ba dang / srin mo rnam par 'phyang ma zhes bya ba dang / srin mo so brtsegs zhes bya ba dang / srin mo me tog so zhes bya ba dang / srin mo cod pan so zhes bya ba dang / srin mo skra 7)can zhes bya ba dang / srin mo me zhes bya ba dang / srin mos8phreng ba 'chang zhes bya ba dang / srin mo mdung can zhes bya ba dang / srin mo sems can thams cad kyi mdangs 'phrog ces bya ba dang ske/ 'phrog ma bu dang g.yog tu bcas pa dang / srin mo de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas/ srin mo de dag thams cad kyis sgra skad gcig tu bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa chos smra ba 'di lta bu de dag bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar 9)bgyi'o/ /bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o/ /ci nas chos smra ba de dag la glags lta ba dang skabs tshol ba 51—351

dag gis kyang glags 1mi rnyed par bgyi'o/ /de nas srin mo de dag thams cad kyis nasgra skad gcig tu tshig 'thun par bcom ldan 'das la gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag phul lo/ /tarya thā/ i ti 4me/ i ti 5me/ i ti ci me/ i ti 7me/ i ti name/ ni me/ ni me/ ni me/ ni me/ ni me/ ru he/ ru he / ru he/ ru he/ ru he/ ha ste/ ha ste/ ha ste/ ha ste/ ha ste swā tā9ske/ 'di spyi bor bzhag nas chos smra ba rnams la su yang 'khu bar ma gyur cig /gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/ yi dgas sam/ sha za'am/ srul po'am/gshed 7byed dam/ ro langs sam/ rengs pa'am/ gnon 11po'am/brjid 12byed kyi gzugs sam/ gnod sbyin gyis byas pa'am/ mis byas pa'am/mi ma yin pas byas pa'am// rims nad nyin gcig pa'am/ nyin gnyis pa'am/nyin gsum pa'am/ nyin bzhi pa'am/ rtag pa'i rims sam/ tha na rmi lam na yang bud med kyi gzugs sam/ skyes pa'i gzugs sam/ khye'u'i gzugs sam / bu mo'i gzugs kyis tho 'tshams 12par 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma mchis so / /de nas srin mo de dag gis sgra skad gcig tu 1 tshig 'thun par bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /gang gis gsang sngags 'di thos nas/ /chos smra ba dang 'gal bgyid pa/ /de'i mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gas / /ardza ka yi dog pa bzhin/ /gang zhig chos smra 'gal bgyid pa/ /ma bsad pa yi 'gro gang dang / /pha bsad 'gro ba gang lags pa'i/ /'gro ba de ni der mchi'o/ /gang zhig chos smra 'gal bgyid pa/ /til 'tshir dag gi 'gro gang dang / /til rdung 'gro ba gang lags pa'i/ /'gro ba der ni de mchi'o/ /gang zhig chos smra 'gal bgyid pa/ /srang la g.yo bgyid 'gro gang dang / /bre 1551—352

'chos 'gro ba gang lags pa'i/ /'gro ba der ni de mchi'o17/ /de skad ces gsol nas/ mdung can la sogs pa srin mo de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang chos smra ba 'di lta bu de dag la nabasrung bar bgyi'o/ /bde legs su 'gyur ba dang chad pa spang ba dang dug gzhil bar bgyi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis srin mo de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ kye /srin mo dag legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis chos smra ba de dag la bsrung ba dang /bskyab capa dang / sba ba gyis shig /gang dag tha na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming tsam 'dzin pa de dag la yang / mdung can khyod 'khor dang bcas pas bsrung bar bya na/ gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mtha' dag chub par 'dzin pa dang glegs bam du byas te/ rim gro 5byed pa dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lha'i ba dan dang / 'bru mar gyi mar me'am/ mar gyi mar me'am / spos mar gyi mar me'am tsam pa kya'i mar gyi mar me'am/ par sha ma'i mar gyi mar me'am/ ud pa la'i mar gyi mar me'am/ sna ma'i mar gyi mar me'am/ de lta bu'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnam pa mang po brgya stong gis rim gro byed pa lta ci smos te/ mdung can khyod g.yog dang bcas pas bsrung bar bya'o/ /gzungs sngags kyi le'u 'di bshad pa na srog chags drug khri brgyad stong mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po las gzungs sngags kyi le'u zhes bya ba 7riste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //51—353

de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pas 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi rgyal po 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na rgyu ba dang / bcom ldan 'das 'di dka' ba bgyid 1pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po dag gda'/bcom ldan 'das gang thos pas lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan nas lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang /nyan thos chen po 'di dag gis thos nas thams cad dga' mgu rangs shing yid bde bar 'gyur ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi rgyal po'i spyod pa gang ci lags pa'i phyogs tsam zhig /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis legs par bshad du gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar na ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pas gsol ba btab par ( namakhyen nas/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar 51—354

gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung 1ste/ skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra rten bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal de'i byang chub sems dpa' bye ba brgyad cu'i sa 'dus pa chen po byung ngo / /gang gā'i klung ri bdun cu 5rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyi nyan thos 'dus pa byung ngo / /de'i bstan pa la bud med med par gyur to/ /sems can dmyal ba dang /dud 'gro'i yeskye gnas dang / yi dgas dang / lha ma yin gyi ris med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang lag mthil ltar mnyam la nyams dga' bar gyur to/ /lha'i bai drurya (pelas grub pa'i sa phyogs rin po che dang tsan dan gyi shing ljon pas brgyan zhings2)/ rin po che'i dra bas bres pa dar gyi lda ldi mngon par rab tu spyangs 99 pa rin po che'i pog phor nas bdug pas bdugs pa rin po che'i shing ljon pa'i drung thams cad na rin po che'i mkha' rten mda' rgyang gang gi tshad tsam byas pa yod pa/ rin po che'i mkha' rten thams cad kyi steng na lha'i bu bye ba brgya 1 dag /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/sil snyan byed cing pheg rdob pa dang rol mo'i 11sgra 'byin cing 'khod do/ /bcom ldan 'das de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba las 12brtsams te/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di/ nyan thos chen po de dag dang byang chub 51—355

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la rgyas par rab tu ston to/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal de'i tshe'i tshad ni bskal pa bzhi khri nyis stong du gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang nyan thos chen po de dag gi tshe'i tshad kyang de tsam du gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba de yang / bcom ldan 'das de'i gsung rab la dka' ba byed pa la brtson par gyur te/ de lo khri nyis stong du 'chag pa la zhugs shing brtson 'grus chen po brtsams pas rnal 'byor la brtson par gyur to/ /de lo khri nyis stong 'das nas gzugs thams cad yang dag par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob ste1/ ting nge 'dzin de thob ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba de tshim zhing mgu ste yi narangs nas rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas/ de'i tshe 'di snyam du sems te/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la brten nas gzungs thams cad yang dag par ston pa zhes bya ba'i cating nge 'dzin bdag gis 5thob po snyam mo/ /de'i smi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba yang 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal dang dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mchod par bya'o snyam nas/ de'i tshe de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/51—356

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba'i 1ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de'i mod la steng gi bar snang las me tog man dā 2ra dang / man dā 3ra chen po'i lha'i me tog gi char chen po mngon par bab po/ /dus kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i tsan dan gyis 4)sprin byas 5te/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i char chen po 6mngon par bab ste ske/ skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de lta bu'i spos kyi rnam pa zho gnyis kyi rin du 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dis mi chog go / /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du ting nge 'dzin de las langs so/ /langs nas 'di snyam du sems te ci 8ltar lus yongs su btang ba ltar ni rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dag gis/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas pa ma yin no snyam mo/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba de de'i tshe/ a ga ru dang / du ru kṣ-i ka dang / pog gi khu ba za zhing tsam pa ku'i mar yang 'thung ngo / /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ rnam grangs 'dis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba/ rtag tu spos za 11zhing tsam pa ku'i 12mar 'thung bas lo bcu gnyis 'das par gyur to/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba/ lo

bcu gnyis po de 'das nas rang gi lus lha'i ras kyis kun tu te1dkris nas 'bru mar gyis zhen par byas te bdag gi byin gyis brlabs 5byas so/ /bdag gis byin gyis brlabs 5)byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mchod pa'i las kyi phyir bdag gi lus la me 'bar bar byas so/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba'i lus kyi mar me 'bar ba de'i 'od kyis / 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung brgyad cu'i 5bye ma snyed khyab par gyur te/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung brgyad cu'i'6)bye ma snyed thams cad kyis legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi brtson 'grus rtsom pa yang dag pa'o/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang chos la mchod pa yang dag pa ste/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang /phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / lha'i ba dan gyis mchod pa dang / zang zing gis mchod pa dang ske/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying pos mchod pa ni de lta ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu sbyin pa 'di ni mchog ste/ rgyal srid yongs su gtong ba'i sbyin pa ni de lta ma yin rnam/ /bu dang chung ma phangs pa yongs su gtong ba'i sbyin pa yang de lta ma yin no//rigs kyi bu gang bdag gi 7)lus gtong ba'i chos kyi mchod pa 'di ni mchod pa khyad par can no/ /dam pa'o/ /mchog go/ /phul lo/ /gya rnam pa'o/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 51—358

'das de dag gis tshig de skad ces gsungs nas de nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to / /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba'i lus la te/'bar ba lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du zhi bar ma song ngo / /de phyis lo bcu gnyis 'das nas zhi bar gyur ton/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong rinon dga' ba des/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'di lta bu'i mchod pa dang chos kyi mchod pa byas te/ de nas shi 'phos canas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 5nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal gyi gsung rab la rgyal po dri ma med pas byin pa'i khyim du skyes te/ skyil mo krung bcas bzhin du pang par rdzus 6te skyes par 7gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba skyes ma thag tu/ de'i tshe rang gi pha ma la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ rgyal mchog 'di na bdag 'chag cing / /der gnas bdag gis 8ting 'dzin thob/ /bdag gi 57lus phangs yongs btang ste/ /brtson 'grus sra brtsams brtul 1 kyizhugs che/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' bas 17tshigs su bcad pa de smras nas/ rang gi pha ma la 'di skad ces yab yum bcom ldan 'das gang la bdag gis mchod nas/sgra thams cad la mkhas pa'i gzungs thob cing / dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang tshigs su bcad pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 51—359

gtams pa dang / dkrigs pa dang mi 'khrugs pa bye ba 17phyag brgyad cus /bcom ldan 'das de las thos par gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal de da 5ltar yang bzhugs te 'tsho zhing 4rigazhes kyis kyi/ yab yum bdags6 bcom ldan 'das de'i drung du mchis na legs so/ /der mchis nas yang bcom ldan 'das de la mchod pa bgyi'o zhes smras so/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba de'i tshe/ nam mkha' la shing ta la bdun tsam du mngon par 'phags te/ rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs par skyil mo krung bcas nas bcom ldan 'das de'i drung du song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das de la lan bdun bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te tshigs su bcad pa 'dis mngon par bstod do/ /dpa' bo mi dbang shin tu dri med zhal / /phyogs bcu 'dir ni khyod kyi 7'od zer mdzes/ /bde gshegs khyod la bdag gis mchod mchog bgyis/ /mgon po lta ba'i slad du bdag 'dir mchis//skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' bas tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs 8pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das khyod da dung 51—360

bzhugs sam/ skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu nga yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 1dus la bab ste/ rigs kyi bu nga tshe zad pa'i dus la bab kyis na rigs kyi bu khyod song la/ nga'i khri shoms shig dang nga yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu bstan pa 'di ngas khyod la yongs su gtad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di dag dang / nyan thos chen po 'di dag dang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'di dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag dang /rin po che'i mkha' rten 'di dag dang / rin po che'i shing ljon pa 'di dag dang nga'i bsnyen bkur byed pa'i lha'i bu 'di rnams kyang yongs su gtad do/ /rigs kyi bu nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i ring bsrel dgang yin pa de dag kyang yongs su gtad do/ /rigs kyi bu nga'i ring bsrel la khyod kyis kyang ri mchod pa rgya cher gyis shig /ring bsrel de dag kyang rgyas par gyis shig /mchod rten stong phrag mang po gyis shig /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag 51—361

par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba de la de ltar rjes su bstan nas/ de'i nub mo nam gyi cha smad la phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' bas / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal de yongs su mya ngan las 'das par rig ste/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po spungs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsregs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshig pa zhi bar rig nas ring bsrel tshobasdus te ngu zhing cho nges btab nas smre sngags 'don to / /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba ngus te cho nges btab nas smre sngags 'don te ni/ rin po che sna bdun gyi bum pa brgyad khri bzhi stong byed du bcug nas/ de dag gi nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bcug ste/ rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten 'phang du tshangs pa'i 'jig rten la thug 5pa gdugs kyi phreng bas legs par brgyan pa dare dang dril bu legs par spyangs 4pa brgyad khri bzhi stong byas te/ des mchod rten de dag byas nas 'di snyam du bsams te bdag gis bcom ldan 'das nyi zla dri ma med pa'i 'od dpal/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung la mchod pa ni byas na de bas kyang lhag pa ches khyad par du 'phags pas 5de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel 6la mchod pa bya'o snyam mo/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa 51—362

mngon par shes pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba des thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs de dang / nyan thos chen po de dag dang / lha dang / klu dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i tshogs de dag la smras pa/ rigs kyi bu dag khyed thams cad kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de'i ring bsrel rnams la mchod pa bya bar soms shig /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba des/ de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad khri bzhi stong gi mdun du/ rang gi lag pa bsod nams brgyas brgyan pa 'bar bar byas te/ 'bar bar byas pas ga1)lo bdun khri nyis stong gi bar du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten de dag la mchod pa byas so/ /des mchod pa de byas pas 'khor de las nyan thos grangs med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong btul lo ri/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis kyang gzugs 5)thams cad yang dag par ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun 4tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs de dang / nyan thos chen po de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba de yan lag ma tshang bar mthong nas ngus te cho nges btab nas smre sngags 'don cing gcig la gcig 'di skad du55༄smras te bdag cag gi slob dpon rjes su ston pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 51—363

sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba 'di da ltar yan lag ma tshang zhing lag pa med par gyur to zhes zer ro/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas 1pa mngon par shes pa de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba des/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' nachen po de dag dang / nyan thos chen po na de dag dang lha'i bu de dag la smras pa rigs kyi bu dag kho bo'i 4yan lag nyams par mthong bas ma ngu shig /cho nges ma 'debs shig /smre sngags ma 'don cig /rigs kyi bu dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag bzhugs shing 'tsho zhing gzhes 55pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kho bos dpang 65du bzhag ste ni/ de dag gi spyan sngar bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs naso/ /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis bdag gi lag pa de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i phyir yongs su btang bas/bdag gi lus gser gyi kha dog 9)tu 'gyur ba'i bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig des / bdag gi lag pa 'di sngon gyi bzhin du gyur cig /sa chen po 'di lan drug tu g.yos par gyur cig /bar snang la gnas pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis me tog gi char chen po phob shig ces byas so/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba des/ bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs 1 de byas ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /steng gi bar snang las kyangs tog gi char chen po mngon par bab po/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can 51—364

thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba de'i lag pa de yang / 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de nyid kyi bsod nams kyi stobs bskyed pa dang ske/ ye shes kyi stobs bskyed pa des sngon gyi bzhin du gyur to/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas 1pa mngon par shes pa/ de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin snyam du/ khyod som nyi'am yid gnyis sam the tshom za bar gyur na skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa khyod kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi rgyal po 'di nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba zhes bya bar gyur to//skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa nabyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi rgyal po bya dka' ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong de snyed byed do/ /lus yongs su gtong ba 3yang byed do/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'di 'dod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten de dag la rkang pa'i mthe bong 'bar bar bya'o/ /lag pa'i sor mo'am rkang pa'i sor mo gcig gam yan lag gcig gam lag pa 'bar bar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de ni bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa ches mang du skyed do/ /rgyal srid yongs su 51—365

btang bas ni de lta ma yin no/ /chung ma dang bu pho dang bu mo phangs pa yongs su btang bas ni de lta ma yin no/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na nags tshal dang bcas pa rgya mtsho dang bcas pa ri dang bcas pa 'bab chu'i dngo 1)dang mtsho dang mtshe'u dang khron pa dang kun dga'i ra ba dang bcas pa yongs su btang bas ni de lta ma yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun gyis rab tu gang bar byas te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la sbyin pa byin na/ skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de ni/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu moshogegang gis / dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las/ tha na tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam 'dzin pa de bsod zhu)nams ji snyed cig skyed pa de snyed du mi skyed de/ de'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa 'di ni de bas ches mang bar bshad kyi/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun gyis rab tu gegang bar byas te/ sanges rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dnga'5)rang sangs rgyas thams cad la sbyin pa byin pa ni de lta ma yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa 'di lta ste dper na 'bab chu'i dngo ne dang mtsho dang mtshe'u thams cad kyi nang na rgya mtsho ni mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa 51—366

thams cad kyisalo7bshad pa'i mdo sde thams cad kyi nang na dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ 'di lta ste dper na ri nag po dang khoras yug dang khor yuganeXchen po thams cad kyi nang na ri rabs ni ri'i rgyal po ste mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i mdo sde thams cad kyi nang na/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rgyal po ste mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ 'di lta ste dper na skar ma thams cad kyi nang na zla ba ni 'od byed pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i mdo sde thams cad kyi nang na/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni zla ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong bas lhag par 'od byed pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ 'di lta ste dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni mun pa mun gnag 5thams cad sel bar byed do/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de bzhin du dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i 56)chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang mi dge ba'i mun pa mun gnag 7thams cad sel bar byed do/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ 'di lta ste dper na/ sum cu /rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi nang na brgya byin ni lha rnams kyi dbang po yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par 9shes pa/ de bzhin du dam pa'i 51—367

chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i mdo sde thams cad kyi nang na dbang po yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa 'di lta ste dper na/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa ni tshangs ris kyi lha thams nyacad kyi rgyal po ste tshangs pa'i 'jig rten na pha'i bya ba byed do/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de bzhin du dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang sems can slob pa dang mi slob pa thams cad dang nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa thams cad la pha'i bya ba byed do/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ 'di lta ste dper na/ rgyun du zhugs pa dang lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang phyir mi 'ong ba dang dgra bcom pa dang rang sangs rgyas rnams ni byis pa so so'i skye bo thams cad las 'das pa'o/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa de bzhin du dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pas nagasungs pa'i mdo sde thams cad las 'das shing mngon par 'phags te/ mchog tu gyur par rig par bya'o/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa gang dag mdo sde'i rgyal po 'di 'dzin pa rde dag kyang sems can thams cad kyi gtso bor gyur par rig par bya'o/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ 'di lta ste dper na/nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nang na byang chub sems dpa' ni mchog ces bya'o/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/de bzhin du dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang de 51—368

bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i mdo sde thams cad kyi nang na 1/mchog ces bya'o / /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ 'di lta ste dper na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi nang na de bzhin gshegs pa ni chos kyi rgyal por thabs gsol ba yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de bzhin du dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'dra ba yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pal/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni sems can thams cad 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa/ sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar byed pa ste/ skom pa rnams la mtshe'u dang 'dra'o/ /grang bas nyen pa rnams la me dang 'dra'o/ /gcer bu rnams la gos dang 'dra'o/ /tshong pa rnams la ded dpon dang 'dra'o/ /bu rnams la ma dang 'dra'o/ /pha rol du 'gro ba rnams la gru dang 'dra'o/ /nad pa rnams la sman pa dang 'dra'o/ /mun pa mun gnag gis bsgribs pa rnams la mar me dang 'dra'o/ /nor 'dod pa rnams la rin po che dang 'dra'o/ /khams kyi rgyal po thams cad la 'khor los nasgyur ba dang 'dra'o/ /'bab chu rnams la rgya mtsho dang 'dra'o/ /mun pa mun gnag thams cad sel ba'i phyir sgron ma dang 'dra'o/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de bzhin du dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang sdug bsngal thams cad las rab tu thar bar byed pa'o/ /nad thams cad gcod pa'o/ /'khor ba'i bcing ba nyam nga ba 51—369

thams cad las rab tu thar bar byed pa'o/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par ha)shes pa/ gang gis dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pa dang gang yi ger 'dri ba dang gang yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ gang gisalgechos kyi rnam grangs 'di bzungalosangam bstan tamage/ thos sam/ yi ger bris sam / yi ger 'drir 'jug gam/ glegs bam du byas te/ bstirsā)stang du byed pa dang / btsun par byed pa dang / bkur ster byed pa dang / mchod pa dang ske/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang ske/ phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / na bza' dang / thal mo sbyar ba'i las dang /mar gyi mar me'am/ 'bru mar gyi mar me'am/ spos mar gyi mar me'am/tsam pa ma'i mar gyi mar me'am/ sna ma dang skya snar nenadang / bar sha ka dang /na pa ma li ma'i mar gyi mar me'am/ mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis bste7)stang du byed/ btsun par byed/ rim gror byed/ mchod par byed pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa ji snyed cig 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa de dag gi mtha' ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis skyong rtogs par mi nus so/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa / gang zhig sman gyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi sbyor ba'i le'u 'di 'dzin pa dang ston pa dang nyan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyil)bu mo byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa de bsod nams mang du skyedam9)par 'gyur ro/ /gal te bud med gcig gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas 'dzin na/ de nyid bud 51—370

med kyi lus kyi mtha'amadzo)mar 'gyur ro/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ bud med gang la las sman gyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi sbyor ba'i le'u 'di lnga brgya pa tha ma la thos nas nan tan byed pa de/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur te/ gang na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes napa der/ de pad ma'i snying po'i /seng ge'i khri la 'dug bzhin du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de 'dod chags kyis gzir bar mi 'gyur te )ske/ zhe sdang gis ma yin gti mug gis ma yin nga rgyal gyis ma yin ser snas ma yin khro bas ma yin gnod sems kyis ma yin te/ de skyes ma thag tu mngon par shes pa lnga thob par 'gyur ro/ /mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa yangs5thob par 'gyur ro/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob nas / de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung bdun cu 6rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mig gi dbang po yongs su dag pa gang gis/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag mthong bar 'gyur ba de 'dra bar de'i 7mig gi dbang po yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis kyang de la legs so zhes bya ba sbyin par 'gyur te/ gang khyod kyis dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de'i gsung rab la lung mnos pa dang kha don 44)byas pa dang bsgoms spyo pa dang 51—371

bsams pa dang yid la byas pa dang sems can gzhan dag la yang rab tu bstan pa / rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa 'di ni mes tshig pa'am chus khyer bar mi nus so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa 'di ni sangs rgyas brgyasanyu)stong gis kyang bshad par mi nus so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdud phyir rgol ba bcom mo/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho las brgal 5)to/ /dgra'i tsher ma dkrugs so/ /sangs rgyas brgya 35stong gis byin gyis brlabs so/ /rigs kyi bu lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na khyod 'dra ba med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gcig pu ma gtogs par gzhan nyan thos sam rang sangs rgyas sam byang chub sems dpa' gang gis kyang / khyod la bsod nams kyis kyang rung / ye shes kyis kyang rung /shes rab kyis kyang rung / ting nge 'dzin gyis ca)kyang rung ste/ zil gyis gnon par mi nus so/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ye shes kyi stobs bskyed pa 'di lta bu thob par 'gyur ro/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa / gang la las sman gyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi sbyor ba'i le'u 'di bshad pa thos nas/legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin pa de'i kha nas ud pa la'i dri 'byung bar snye 'gyur / de'i lus las kyang tsan dan gyi dri 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chad pa na legs so zhes bya ba byin pa de'i chos can gyi yon tan gyi phan yon de dag ni/ ngas da ltar gang dag bshad pa de 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad kyis 51—372

mthong na dga' ba'i sngon gyi sbyor ba'i le'u 'di ci nas/ phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya pa tha ma la 'dzam bu'i 1)gling 'di na spyod cing nub par mi 'gyur ba dang /bdud sdig can gyis glags mi rnyed pa dang bdud kyi ris kyi lha dang klu dang gnod nasbyin dang dri za dang grul bum rnams kyis glags mi rnyed par bya ba'i phyir ngas khyod la yongs su gtad do/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa / de lta bas na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sems can nad pa nad kyis btab pa rnams la sman lta bur 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab par byas te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas lus la nad kyis 5mi zug go/ /rga bas ma yin dus ma yin par 'chi bas ma yin no/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ gal te byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa gang la las/ mdo sde 'di 6'dzin pa'i dge slong de lta bu de mthong na/ de la tsan dan gyi phye ma dang ud pa la sngon pos mngon par gtor bar bya'o/ /mngon par gtor nas kyang 'di snyam du rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub kyi snying por 'gro bar 'gyur/ 'di ni rtswa len par 'gyur/ 'di ni byang chub kyi snying por rtswa 'ding bar 'gyur/ 'di ni bdud kyi phyogs pham par byed par 'gyur/ 'di ni chos kyi dung 'bud par 'gyur/ 'di ni chos kyi rnga rdung 3)bar 'gyur/ 'di ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rgal 8bar 'gyur ro snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o/ /skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pas༄9)/ mdo sde 'di lta bu 'dzin pa'i dge slong mthong nas de ltar sems bskyed par byas te/ de ltar na de'i yon tan dag ni de bzhin gshegs 51—373

pas ci 'dra ba dag bshad pa de 'dra ba dag tu 'gyur ro/ /sman gyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi sbyor ba'i le'u 'di bshad pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad khri bzhi stong gis/ sgra thams cad la mkhas pa dang ldan pa'i gzungs thob par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang des kyang / skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa/ de ltar khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la bsam gyis tsho1)mi khyab pa'i yon tan gyi chos dris pa legs so legs so zhes rin)bya ba byin no/ / dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po las (sman gyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi sbyor ba'i le'u zhes bya ba nguste nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas de'i tshe/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od phyungasnyiste/ 'od des shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gang gā'i klung bcwa57brgyad kyi bye ma snyed dag khyab par byas te2/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gang gā'i klung bcwastonasabargyad kyi bye ma snyed57de dag 'das pa de na 'jig rten gyi khams rnarme par snang ba'i 'od zer gyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba de na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad ma'i 'dab ma dri ma med pa skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhesamatshal / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rgya chen po tshad med pas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 51—374

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa des mdzod spu nas 'od gang btang ba des/ de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang ba'i 'od zer gyis brgyan pa de snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang ba'i 'od zer gyis brgyan pa de na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs zhes bya ba dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa sngon yang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mang po'i 'od zer de lta bu mthong zhing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis ting nge 'dzin mang po thob pa 'di lta ste/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin thob/dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ dri ma med pas byin pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ skar ma'i rgyal po rnam par rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob/rlung lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ ye shes kyi phyag 1rgya'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ zla ba sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ sgra thams cad la mkhas45pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob / bsod nams thams cad kun las bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ dad pa can gyi ting nge 'dzin thob/ rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ ye shes ta la la'i ting nge 'dzin thob / bkod pa'i rgyal po'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi ting nge 'dzin thob/ dri ma med pa'i snying po'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ zad par chub pa'i nating nge 'dzin thob/ / nyi ma'i 9)'khor ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis/ ting nge 'dzin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar du thob par 51—375

'dug ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs de'i lus la 'od des phog par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad ma'i 'dab ma dri ma med pa skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la blta ba dang phyag bgyi ba dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa de yang blta ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' sman gyi rgyal po de yang blta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rab tu sbyin pa de yang blta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa mngon par shes pa de yang blta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa khyad par can de yang blta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' bkod 1pa'i rgyal po de yang blta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sman yang dag 'phags de yang blta ba'i slad du/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du mchi'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad ma'i 'dab ma dri ma med pa skar ma'i rgyal po me snye tog kun tu rgyas pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i 2dbyangs la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der song ste phyin nas/ ngan pa'i 'du shes bskyed par mi bya'o / /rigs kyi bu 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed de ni mthon 5dman can dang ske/ sa las grub pa dang / ri nag pos gang ba dang / 'jim ngan gyis 51—376

yongs su gang ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de yang sku thung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kyang lus thung ngo / /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi lus thob pa ni dpag tshad bzhi khri nyis stong ngo / /rigs kyi bu snanga'i lus ni dpag tshad 'bum phrag drug cu nartsa brgyad yod do/ /rigs kyi bu khyod ni mdzes pa blta na sdug pa gzugs bzang ba kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/bsod nams brgya stong bas shin tu lhag pa'i dpal dang ldan pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bas na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du phyin nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing de la ngan pa'i 'du shes ma skyed cig /de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad ma'i 'dab ma dri ma med pa skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa de la 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbyin gyi rlabs cadang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bskyed 5pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par rol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon par 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der mchi'ol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi 6zhing de nas ma g.yos shing / stan de las ma langs par 'di lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs de ting nge 'dzin 51—377

de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu/ de'i mod la 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du / bya rgod kyi phung po'i ris1la de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi gdan gyi drung du/pad ma chu ba ni gser 'dab ma ni dngul snying po ni pad ma dang ne tso'am ci las grub pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu'agertsa bzhi byung bar gyur to/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/ pad ma bkod pa byung ba de mthong nas/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar chu ba ni gser 'dab ma ni dngul snying po ni pad ma dang ne tso'am ci las grub pa'i pad ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu ri rtsa bzhi gda' ba 'di su'i snga ri ltas lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal 'di ni shar phyogs logs nas 'jig rten gyi khams 45)rnam par snang ba'i 'od zer gyis brgyan pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad ma'i 'dab ma dri ma med pa skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag rmi khrig brgya stong gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ ngas46kyil blta ba dang ske/ phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan 7pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ong ba 8de'i snga ltas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs 51—378

kyi bu des dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs ci bgyis na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs bsags pa des 'di lta bu'i khyad par 'di thob/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' de ting nge 'dzin gang la spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin de bcom ldan 'das bdag gis mnyan par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis ting nge 'dzin de la spyad par bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ci 'dra ba dang kha dog ci 'dra ba dang gzugs ci 'dra ba dang rtags ci 'dra ba dang dbyibs ci 'dra ba dang de'i spyod pa ci lags 1)pa/ bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de blta bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das brda ltas gang gis bskul ma thag tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir mchi bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i brda ltas shig de bzhin gshegs pas legs par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa rin chen mang la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /ci nas brda ltas gang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir mchi ba de lta bu'i brda ltas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzod cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par nardzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa rin chen mang gis de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos nasang sang po'i dbyangs bskul ba'i phyir/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'di rigs kyi bu khyod kyi mthu ( rimathong bar dga' bas rigs kyi bu khyod 51—379

'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir shog cig ces de lta bu'i brda mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad ma'i 'dab ma dri ma med pa skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa de'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu 1)rtsa bzhi po de dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas lhan cig tu 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang ba'i 'od zer gyis brgyan pa de nas mi snang bar gyur rinas/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 5'dir 'ongs te/ zhing dag ni rab tu g.yo bar byed/pad ma'i char ni rab tu 'bebs/ sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong ni len cing ske/ mig ni ud pa la sngon po'i 'dab ma 'dra/ bzhin ni zla ba bye ri rib khrag khrig brgya stong bas lhag /lus kyi mdog ni gser gyi kha dog 'dra la/ lus bsod nams brgya stong gis ni brgyan/ dpal gyis ni rab tu 'bar/ gzi brjid kyis ni shin tu lhang nger 5gyur/ lus ni mtshan rnams kyis rnam par spras/lus sred med kyi bu'i lus ltar ni mkhregs 6)pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs par zhugs te/ nam mkha' la ta la bdun tsam nas byang chub sermis dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas 'ongs te/ de 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di ga la ba dang bya rgod phung po'i ri ga la ba der 'ongs te phyin nas/ khang pa brtsegs pa de nas babs te/ brgya stong ri ba'i mu tig gi phreng ba thogs shing / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song nas phyin pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan bdun 51—380

bskor 1)ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa nabya ba'i phyir mu tig gi phreng ba phul lo/ /phul nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad ma'i 'dab ma dri ma med pa skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa bcom ldan 'das la gnod pa nyung ngam nyam nga ba nyung ngam bskyod pa yang ngam/stobs dang bde bar gnas sam zhes snyun gsol lo / /bcom ldan 'das de 'di skad ces kyang gsung ste )/ bcom ldan 'das khyod bzod dam/ gzhes sam / khams rnams 'thun nam/ khyod kyi sems can rnams 5go sla'am/gdul sla'am/ gsol6)sla'am/ gtsang ma 'dod dam/ ha cang 'dod chags mi spyod dam/ ha cang zhe sdang mi spyod dam/ ha cang gti mug mi spyod dam/bcom ldan 'das khyod kyi sems can dag shin tu phrag dog can ma yin nam/ser sna can ma yin nam/ mar mi 'dzin pa ma yin nam/ phar mi 'dzin pa ma yin nam/ dge slong du mi 'dzin pa ma yin nam/ bram zer mi 'dzin pa ma yin nam/ log par lta ba ma yin nam/ sems ma dul ba ma yin nam/dbang po ma bsrungs pa ma yin nam/ bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis sems can de dag gis bdud phyir rgol ba bcom mam7/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa rin chen mang den/ rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten gyi nang na bzhugs pa chos gsan pa'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du gshegs sam/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la yang bcom ldan 'das de 'dri ba/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang de bzod dam/51—381

gzhes 1)sam/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang ring du gzhes nasam zhes gsung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang de'i ring bsrel gyi sku blta bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang de'i ring bsrel ri/gyi sku/ de bzhin gshegs pas legs par bstan du gsol / de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa rin chen mang de la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs 'di bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa rin chen mang mthong bar 'tshal nas mchis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu khyod nga dang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa mthong bar 'dod pa dang / dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa legs so legs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyis 'di skad 51—382

ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa gang gi drung du sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba ji lta bu zhig bskrun/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa mthong na dga' ba la/'jig rten gyi khams gzugs thams cad shin tu ston par de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sprin dang rnga sgra rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di 'jig rten du byung ste/ rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 1sprin dang rnga sgra rgyal po de la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis sil snyan brgya stong rab tu blangs te/ lo khri nyis stong du mchod pa byas so/ /rin po che sna bdun gyi snod brgyad khri bzhi stong phul lo/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa sprin dang rnga sgra rgyal po'i gsung rab de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis de lta bu'i dad pa thob po/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin dang rnga sgra rgyal po la mchod pa byas shing snod brgyad khri bzhi stong de dag phul ba de/ gzhan zhig yin snyam du khyod som nyi'am yid gnyis sam the tshom za bar gyur na rigs kyi bu khyod 51—383

kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu gang gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin dang rnga sgra rgyal po de la mchod pa byas pa dang / snod de dag kyang phul ba de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs 'di nyid yin te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs de ni sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ sangs rgyas brgya stong mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ yongs su sbyang ba byas pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs 'dis sngon yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ngo / /pad ma'i dpal khyod kyis 1 byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs 'di mthong ngam/ pad ma'i dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ pad ma'i dpal byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs 'di ni/ gzugs mang pos dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ston te/ 'di lta ste/ la lar ni tshangs pa'i gzugs kyis/ la lar ni brgya dbyin gyi gzugs kyis/ la lar ni dbang phyug gi gzugs kyis/ la lar ni dbang phyug chen po'i gzugs kyis/ la lar ni dmag dpon gyi gzugs kyis/ la lar ni mchog gi gzugs kyis/ la lar ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i gzugs kyis/ la lar ni khams kyi rgyal po'i gzugs kyisal/ la lar ni tshong dpon gyi gzugs kyis/ la lar ni khyim bdag gi gzugs kyis/ la lar ni grong mi'i gzugs kyis/ la lar ni bram ze'i 51—384

gzugs kyis dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ston to/ /la lar ni dge slong gi gzugs kyis/ la lar ni dge slong ma'i gzugs kyis/la lar ni dge bsnyen gyi gzugs kyis/ la lar ni dge bsnyen ma'i gzugs kyis/la lar ni tshong dpon gyi chung ma'i gzugs kyis/ la lar ni khyim bdag gi chung ma'i gzugs kyis/ la lar ni grong mi'i chung ma'i gzugs kyis/ la lar ni khye'u'i 1gzugs kyis/ la lar ni bu mo'i gzugs kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs nadam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sems can rnams la ston te/ rigs kyi bu gzugs 'di snyed cig kun tu ston pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 5sang sang po'i dbyangs dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sems can rnams la ston to/ /kha cig la ni gnod sbyin gyi gzugs kyi bar gyis la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis / dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sems can rnams la ston to/ /kha cig la ni 5lha ma yin gyi gzugs kyis/ kha cig la ni 6nam mkha' lding gi gzugs kyis/ kha cig la ni 7mi'am ci'i gzugs kyis/kha cig la ni na/sto 'phye chen po'i gzugs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sems can rnams la ston to/ /sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang mi khom par skyes pa'i bar gyi sems can rnams la yang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs ri9skyob par 'gyur ro/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyi 1 nang na 'dug pa'i bar 51—385

gyi sems can rnams la yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po7)sang sang po'i dbyangs bud med 5kyi gzugs su mngon par sprul te/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /pad ma'i dpal byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjedam ridu skyes pa'i sems can rnams la skyob pa ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs 'di de snyed 4)kyi gzugs su sprul pas/ dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sems can rnams la ston te/ skyes bu dam pa 'di rdzu 'phrul yang 5nyams pa ne med/ shes rab kyang nyams pa med do/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs ni ye shes kyi snang ba 'di snyed kyis 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na snang ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams gzhan gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na yang / byang chub sems dpasamanya'adul ba'i sems can rnams la 'di byang chub sems dpa'i48)gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /nyan thos kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la nyan thos kyi gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /rang sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la rang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs kyis chos ston to / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi bar gyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel59)ston to/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar gyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la bdag yongs su mya ngan 51—386

las 'das par ston to/ /pad ma'i dpal de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 1sang sang po'i nadabyangs ni ye shes kyi stobs bskyed pa thob pa'o //de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i 4tshodapal gyis 557'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa 'di/ bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin gang la gnas te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis/ sems can 'di snyed btul ba'i ting nge 'dzin de gang lags/ de skad ces gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu ting nge 'dzin gang la gnas te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis 6'di ltar sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byas pa ni/ gzugs thams cad yang dag par ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'di yin no/ /sang sang po'i dbyangs kyi le'u 'di bshad pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs dang lhan cig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu 7rtsa bzhi gang dag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir lhags na pa de dag thams cad kyis gzugs 9thams cad yang dag par ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di 1 na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bgrang ba las 'das pa de dag gis kyang / gzugs thams cad yang dag par ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin 51—387

thob par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang gi ring bsrel gyi mchod rten la yangs shing rgya che ba'i mchod pa byas nas/rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs par zhugs 1te/ zhing rnams ni rab tu g.yo bar byed/ pad ma'i char ni rab tu 'bebs/ sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong ni len cing / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu dam bzhis yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar nas/ lhan cig tu slar rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs dkyirgyas pad ma'i 'dab ma dri ma med pa skar ma'i rgyal po me tog kun tu rgyas pa la 'di skadam )ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du bdag gis sems can gyi don byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang gi ring bsrel gyi mchod rten yang mthong ngo lda/ /phyag kyang bgyis so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa yang mthong ste phyag bgyis so/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa de yang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi rgyal po brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyi shugs thob pa de dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu sbyin pa de yang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu ne/rtsa bzhi po de dag thams cad kyis 57—388

kyang gzugs thams cad yang dag par ston pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sang sang po'i dbyangs 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'i le'u 'di bshad pa na1)/ byang chub sems dpa' bzhi khri nyis stong gis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyis kyang / dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ / dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po las2/sang sang po'i dbyangs kyi le'u zhes bya ba ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //cabam po bcu gsum pa ste tha ma'i/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pa stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 6te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 7logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs nadabang phyug ci'i slad du spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces bgyi/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di la sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong ji snyed cig sdug bsngal gang dag myong bar gyur pa de dag gis/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ming thos na/ de dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi phung po de las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 1 spyan ras gzigs dbang 51—389

phyug gi 1)ming 'dzin pa de dag /gal te me'i phung po chen por lhung na yang /de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzi brjid kyis/ me'i phung po chen po de las 5)rab tu 'bar ba las 5thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gal te chu klung dag ④gis khyer la/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 'a)dbang phyug la bos na/ chu klung de dag thams cad kyis sems can de dag thams cad gting tshugs par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu gal te sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong rgya mtsho'i nang du grur zhugs te/ 'gron bu dang / gser dang / nor bu dang /mu tig dang / bai drabya56 dang / dung dang / man shel dang / rdo'i snying po dang ske/ byi ru dang / spug dang / mu tig dmar po la sogs pa'i phyir dong ba de rnams/ rlung nag pos srin mo'i gling du 'phangs par gyur la/ de na sems can gcig 7'ga' zhig gis spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bos na/ de dag thams cad srin mo'i gling de nas thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigasal8)dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces btags so/ /rigs kyi bu gal te bsadam9)par bkri sna rib las spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bos na/ gshed ma de darge gi mtshon de dag dum bu dum bur chag cing grugs 31par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di gnod sbyin dang srin pos gang bar gyur kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ming 'dzin pa la/ de dag thams cad kyi nyi sdang ba'i sems kyis lta yang mi phod do/ /rigs kyi bu sems can la la lcags sgrogatsha1snyedang /51—390

shing sgrog tu bcug par gyur na nyes yod kyang rung nyes med kyang rung na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ming nas phyung bas(1)/ lcags sgrog dang shing sgrog tu bcug pa de nadag gi bu ga bye bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mthu ni de 'dra'o/ /rigs kyi bu gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di g.yon can dang chom rkun dang dgra lag na mtshon thogs pas sa gang bar gyur te/ der ded dpon gcig gis 'dronamasne)po mang po phal po che rin po ches phyug pa ded de dong ba las/ 'dong ba ④de dag gis g.yon can chom rkun dang dgra lag na mtshon thogs pa de dag mthong ste/ mthong nas kyang 'jigs shing skrag ste 5bdag cag skyabs med par shes pa las ded dpon des 'dron 6)po mang po la 'di skad ces ma 'jigs shig /rigs kyi bu dag ma 'jigs shig mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras )/gzigs dbang phyug la sgra skad gcig tu bos shig dang ske/ des khyodaspobacom rkun gyis79)'jigs pa dang dgra'i 'jigs pa 'di las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro zhes bsgo la/ de nas 'dron 1 po mang po thams cad kyis01sgra skad gcig tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bos te/ 'jigs pa med pa'i sbyin pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nya de la phyag 'tshal lo phyag 'tshal lo zhes ming nas phyung ma thag tu/ 'dronas12po phal po che de dag thams cad 'jigs pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mthu ni de 'dra'o/ /rigs kyi bu sems 51—391

can gang dag 'dod chags spyod pa de dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 1dbang phyug la phyag byas na 'dod chags dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag zhe sdang spyod pa de dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag byas na zhe snang dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag gti mug spyod pa de dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag byas na gti mug dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ni rdzu 'phrul che ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu/ bud med bu pho 'dod pa gang la la byang chub sems dpa' ṅgems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal na de las bu pho 'byung ste/ gzugs bzang ba rimadzes pa blta na sdug pa khye'u'i mtshan dang ldan pa/ skye bo mang po'i yid du 'ong zhing sdug pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'byung ngo / /gang bu mo 'dod pa de yang bu mo 'byung ste /gzugs bzang ba mdzes pa blta na sdug pa bu mo'i mtshan dang ldan pa/ skye bo mang po'i yid du 'ong zhing sdug pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa 'byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi 5dbang / phyug gi mthu ni de 'dra'o/ /gang dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 6dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal ba de dag don yod pa'i 'bras bur 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gang zhig byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 7dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal zhing ming 'dzin la/ gang zhig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung drug cu nartsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed dag 51—392

la phyag 'tshal zhing ming 'dzin pa dang / yang gang zhig gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung drug cu 1rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed bzhugs te/ 'tsho zhing gzhes napa de dag la na bza' dang / bsod snyoms dang / gzims cha dang ske/ snyun gyi gsos sman dang / yo byad kyis mchod pa byed na/ rigs kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa de 3tsam zhig skyed/ de skad ces bka' stsal nas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad 4pas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gzhi de las bsod nams bskyed 5pa ni bcom ldan 'das mang lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mang lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gang gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de snyed la bkur sti 6byas pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa dang / gang gis tha na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 7dbang phyug la phyag lan gcig 8byas pa dang ske/ ming 'dzin pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa gnyi ga 9mnyam ste lhag pa yang med 'phags pa yang med do/ /gang gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung drug cu 1 rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed la phyag 'tshal zhing ming 'dzin pa dang / gang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 11dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal zhing ming 'dzin pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de gnyi ga 12bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du yang zad par bya ba sla ba ma yin no / /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 5dbang phyug gi ming 'dzin pa'i bsod nams de ltar dpag tu med do/ /de nas 57—393

bcom ldan 'das la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 1dbang phyug 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na rnam par rgyu/ ji ltar sems can rnams la chos ston/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigasamanadabang phyug gi thabs mkhas pa'i yul ni ci 'dra ba zhig lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu gang dag na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis sems 8can rnams la chos ston pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag yod do/ /gang dag can byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigasam5)dbang phyug byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i gzugs kyis 6chos ston pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag kyang yod do/ /sems can kha cig la ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 7dbang phyug rang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /kha cig la nyan thos kyi gzugs kyis/ kha cig la tshangs pa'i gzugs kyis/ kha cig la brgya na byin gyi gzugs kyis/sems can kha cig la ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 9chen po spyan ras gzigs 1 dbang phyug dri za'i gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /gnod sbyin gyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la ni gnod sbyin gyi gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /dbang phyug gis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la ni dbang phyug gi gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /dbang phyug chen pos 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la ni dbang 51—394

phyug chen po'i gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal pos 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /sha zas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la ni sha za'i gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /mchog gis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la ni mchog gi gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /dmag dpon gyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la ni dmag dpon gyi gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /bram zes 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la ni bram ze'i gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /lag na rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la ni lag na rdo rje'i gzugs kyis chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigasam1)dbang phyug yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan no/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa'atshanachen po spyan ras gzigs ri dbang phyug la mchod cig /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs caridabang phyug 'di 'jigs pa'i sems can rnams la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa ste/de'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa zhes kun gyis shes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la blo gros mi zad pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs 5dbang phyug la chos kyi dgab pa stsal bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de'i dus la bab ne/par shes na byin cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pas bdag gi mgul nas brgya stong ri ba'i mu tig gi do shal bgrol nas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 7la 51—395

chos kyi dgab par byin te/ skyes bu dam pa bdag las chos kyi dgab pa 'di longs 1shig /des nam blangs nas de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis mu tig gi do shal 'di bdag la snying brtse ba'i phyir longasam shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pa la snying brtse ba dang ske/ 'khor bzhi po de dag dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma caskuyin pa la snying brtse ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pa las mu tig gi do shal blangs so/ /blangs nas cha gnyis su bgos te bgos nas cha gcig 5ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phul lo/ /cha gcig ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang gi rin po che'i mchod rten la phul lo/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chon po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na 6de lta bu'i rnam par 'phrul pas rnam par rgyu'o/ /de la de'i chos nyid ni 'di skad ces bya'o / /rgyal mtshan khra bos blo gros mi zad la/ /de yi don gyi rgyu ni kun dris pa//rgyal ba'i 7sras po 'di ltar ci yi phyir/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po zhes 'di bgyi/ /de nas de yis phyogs rnams kun bltas te/ /smon lam rgya mtsho blo gros mi zad pas/ /rgyal mtshan khra bo de la 'di skad smras/ /spyan ras gzigs 851—396

kyi dbang po'i spyod pa nyon/ /bskal pa bsam yas bye ba du ma brgyar/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag bye ba mang po la/ /smon lam ji ltar rab tu rnam par sbyangs/ /de dag kho bos rab tu bshad kyis 1nyon/ /mnyan par byed cing lta bar byed pa dang ske/ / rim gyis nade ltar rjes su dran pa yang / /srog chags rnams ni 'bras bu yod par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal dang ni mya ngan thams cad sol/ /gal te gsod pas me yi dong du yang / /gsad par bya ba'i phyir ni bor ba'i mis / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /chus btab bzhin du me dag zhi bar 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho dang ni mya ngam cargal na yang / /klu dang 'byung po lha ma yin gnas su/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /chu yi nang du 5kyinam yang mi nub bo/ /rab tu sdang ba'i yid kyis gsad 6pa'i phyir/ /ri rab lhun po'i rtse nas bor na yang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /nyi ma lta bur nam mkha' 7gnas par 'gyur/ /gal te rdo rje yi ni ri dag kyang / /gsad na pa'i phyir ni spyi bor 'ongs na yang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /ba spu'i khung tsam gtses ‘ par mi nus so/ /gsad 1 pa'i sems kyis lag na mtshon thogs te/ /dgra tshogs mang pos kun tu bskor na yang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /de ma thag tu byams pa'i sems su 'gyur / /gal te gsod 1 pa nye bar 'ongs nas su/ /gshed ma mi yi dbang du gyur na yang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni/ /de yi mtshon cha dum bu dum bur 'gyur/ /de ste shing ngam lcags las byas pa yi/ /khong sgril dang ni gdos kyis bcings na yang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dran na ni//bcings pa myur du rnam par bcad par 'gyur/ /sngags dang stobs dang sman 51—397
